article.articleHeadline: Satara Dengue Alert : डेंग्यूच्या पार्श्वभूमीवर आरोग्य विभाग अलर्ट; भुईंज परिसरात आरोग्य विभागाची पाहणी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Satara Dengue Alert: Health Department on alert against dengue; Health Department's inspection in the Bhuinj area.
article.articleSummary: Dengue alert issued by Satara district health department for Bhuinj in Wai taluka. Health teams inspected Bhuinj, Degav, and Bopardi; no active fever cases were found during visits. Over the past four months, 26 suspected dengue samples from primary health centers were sent for testing, and 50 individuals were tested by RDKE; none were positive. In Degav, private laboratories reported 12 dengue-positive cases, all of whom have recovered. In response, the PHC Bhuinj, with Degav Gram Panchayat, directed preventive actions: eliminating mosquito breeding sites, removing standing water, and applying larvicides as needed. Field teams are conducting door-to-door fever surveys and public awareness on vector-borne diseases, with household larval indices noted as low. Residents are urged to observe a weekly 'Dry Day' and promptly seek care if fever develops.

triage.headline_ja: サタラ県デング警報：保健局が警戒態勢；ブーインジ地域で保健局が調査
triage.triage_reason: 地域限定の小規模なデング発生で、陽性者は全員回復済み、保健当局による通常の予防対応が実施されており、特段の異常性や拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: インド・マハーラーシュトラ州サタラ県の地域ニュースで、デング陽性12例は全員回復済み。保健局による日常的な媒介蚊対策・啓発活動の報告であり、流行拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola epidemic update - October 1
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) update for the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In the last 24 hours, 76 new confirmed cases were reported across four provinces: Ituri (49), North Kivu (23), Haut-Uélé (3), and Tshopo (1). Five treatment-center deaths (Ituri 4, North Kivu 1) bring the period’s confirmed deaths to 24. There were 20 recoveries after two negative tests (Ituri 19, North Kivu 1). As of 1 October 2026, the DRC has 8,376 cumulative confirmed cases and 4,042 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%). Ituri remains the epicenter, with 75.7% of cumulative cases and 64.5% of new cases; North Kivu CFR is 59.0%. Across seven provinces, 63 of 167 health zones (37.7%) have been affected since the start of the epidemic. Ongoing transmission persists in the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行アップデート - 10月1日
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、累計8,376例・死亡4,042例（CFR 48.3%）と深刻な公衆衛生被害が続き、複数州にまたがる継続的な感染拡大が確認されているため。
triage.notes: 7州にわたり167保健地域中63地域（37.7%）が影響を受けており、CFRが48.3%と高く、継続的な人-人感染が示唆される。既にWHO/国際機関による対応が進行中の大規模流行と推定される。

article.articleHeadline: Tak Perlu Panik Meski Kasus Meningkat, Dinkes Jawa Barat ungkap Cara Ini Ampuh Cegah Sakit Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No Need to Panic Even Though Cases Are Rising, West Java Provincial Health Office Reveals This Method That Effectively Prevents Influenza A
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising in West Java, including Bandung City, where emergency department visits have increased, but officials say infections can be managed at primary care facilities (Puskesmas, clinics, private practice, or hospital polyclinics). West Java's Provincial Health Office urges calm and promotes prevention through healthy living (PHBS) and early detection. Preventive measures include masking to reduce droplet transmission, frequent handwashing, avoiding crowds, avoiding contact with the sick, and maintaining immune health. Symptoms align with flu: fever, aches, headache, nausea, and fatigue. In Tangerang Regency, influenza A cases have also risen, with about 30,000 exposure cases reported from January–September 2026. Timely care and ongoing preventive practices are advised.

triage.headline_ja: パニックになる必要はない、症例増加もインフルエンザA予防に効果的な方法を西ジャワ州保健局が公開
triage.triage_reason: 西ジャワ州でインフルエンザA症例が増加しているが、当局は管理可能と説明しており重症度や異常性の情報が乏しいため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常の増加と見られ、当局はパニック不要と説明。重症度・死亡例等の詳細情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控发国庆假期健康风险提示：当前流感在中低流行水平波动
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC issues National Day holiday health risk advisory: influenza activity currently fluctuating at a mid-to-low level.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-04, during the Chinese National Day holiday, the China CDC reports COVID-19 at a low level and influenza fluctuating at a mid-to-low level. With increased travel, public health guidance urges masking in transport hubs and indoor venues to curb respiratory infections. Dengue fever and chikungunya fever remain active in southern provinces, presenting as scattered cases and local clusters; residents should eliminate standing water, overturn containers, and use mosquito nets and screens, plus personal protection outdoors. Food- and waterborne risks rise during gatherings; practice hand hygiene before meals, separate raw and cooked foods, and stay vigilant for norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease. For outbound travel, monitor destination public health risks and report overseas travel history if ill; on return, seek medical care and disclose travel history. Influenza vaccination is strongly advised as the season approaches after October to reduce severe disease and death risk.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防コントロールセンター、国慶節休暇の健康リスクに関する注意喚起：現在インフルエンザは中低流行レベルで変動
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の定例健康注意喚起であり、COVID-19・インフルエンザは低〜中程度の流行水準で推移、デング熱・チクングニア熱も散発的クラスターにとどまり、異常な公衆衛生事象とは言えない。
triage.notes: 中国CDCによる国慶節休暇前の定例的な健康リスク注意喚起記事。複数疾患（インフルエンザ、COVID-19、デング熱、チクングニア熱、ノロウイルス、手足口病）に言及しているが、いずれも季節的・通常範囲内の流行状況であり、新規の異常事態は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 四川疾控发布10月健康提示：国庆假期人员流动增加 重点防范五类疾病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sichuan CDC releases October health tips: Increased population movement during the National Day holiday; focus on preventing five categories of diseases.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-04, Sichuan Province, China, calls for heightened vigilance during National Day travel against five infectious-health risks: mosquito-borne diseases (dengue fever and chikungunya), influenza, COVID-19, other infectious diarrheal diseases (notably norovirus and rotavirus), and hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD). Dengue and chikungunya risk local spread as travelers return from Southeast Asia, South Asia, South America, and Africa; watch for fever, rash, and joint pain and report travel history. Influenza season has begun; despite COVID-19 staying at low levels, high holiday mobility warrants vaccination for children, the elderly, students, and chronic patients. Norovirus and rotavirus drive autumn-winter diarrhea; emphasize hand hygiene and water/food safety. HFMD peaks October–December; EV-A71 vaccine reduces risk of severe disease. Recommend home ventilation (2–3 times daily, at least 30 minutes) and avoiding gatherings when ill.

triage.headline_ja: 四川疾控发布10月健康提示：国庆假期人员流动増加 重点防范五类疾病（四川省CDC、国慶節連休の人の移動増加に伴い5種類の疾病への注意を呼びかけ）
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性感染症に対する行政からの一般的な健康注意喚起であり、異常な集団発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 内容は四川省当局による季節的な予防啓発情報であり、具体的な症例数や集団発生の報告は含まれていない。デング熱・チクングニア熱は海外渡航者からの持ち込みリスクへの一般的注意喚起に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: India News | Shimla Municipal Corporation Launches Mass Anti-Rabies Vaccination for Stray Dogs, Targets 4,000 Animals
article.articleSummary: Rabies control drive underway in Shimla, Himachal Pradesh, India, targeting stray dogs with mass anti-rabies vaccination. The campaign aims to vaccinate more than 4,000 dogs over 10 days (Oct 3–13) across all 34 wards, involving nine teams (three net-catching, others hand-catching) and about 40 volunteers per team from Shimla, Rajasthan, and Punjab. Initiated Oct 3, the effort continues through Oct 12–13 and is part of the Shimla Municipal Corporation’s collaboration with animal welfare groups and the Animal Husbandry Department, plus veterinary students and experts. Last year saw ~3,700 dogs vaccinated; current drive also supports ABC (animal birth control) efforts including sterilisation in Rampur, Kotkhai, Jubbal, and Rohru. Targeting 70–80% herd immunity, organizers urge residents not to provoke stray dogs and to avoid interaction if uncomfortable, with vaccination seen as essential to breaking rabies transmission.

triage.headline_ja: インド:シムラー市当局が野良犬への大規模狂犬病ワクチン接種を開始、4,000頭を目標
triage.triage_reason: これは定例の野良犬向け狂犬病予防ワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、異常な集団発生や人への感染拡大は報告されておらず、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies Belum Ada Obatnya, Ahli Ungkap Pentingnya Vaksin dan Serum Usai Digigit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is no cure yet for rabies; experts reveal the importance of vaccines and serum after a bite.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains incurable once clinical symptoms appear, making post-bite management critical. Experts emphasize administering rabies vaccine and rabies immune serum after suspected exposure to a rabid animal. The vaccine enables antibody development, typically taking one to two weeks; the serum helps neutralize the virus when it is suspected to have entered the body. In some cases, vaccines and serum may be given together based on medical judgment. Rabies is nearly always fatal once symptoms start, reflecting CNS involvement including the brain. The incubation period averages two to three months but can range from weeks to over a year. Do not wait for symptoms; first aid includes washing the wound with running water and soap, then seeking medical care. In Jakarta, facilities offering vaccines/serum include RSPI Prof. Dr. Sulianti Saroso and RSUD Tarakan; others require confirmation of availability.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病に治療薬なし、専門家が咬傷後のワクチンと血清の重要性を説く
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の一般的な予防・治療啓発記事であり、特定の集団発生や異常事態の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の一般的な医療啓発情報であり、ジャカルタでの具体的な発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: गाय-भैंस में शरीर पर दिखें गोल गांठें तो न करें नजरअंदाज, जानें लंपी के लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cows and buffaloes: If you notice round lumps on the body, don’t ignore them; learn the symptoms of Lumpy Skin Disease.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) in cows and buffaloes is highlighted in Sultanpur via a Local 18 interview with veterinary scientist Dr. Divakar Kumar of Krishi Vigyan Kendra Sultanpur. LSD is a contagious viral illness transmitted primarily through blood-sucking insects, flies, mosquitoes, and ticks, with higher risk during rainy, humid seasons. Main signs include high fever, reduced appetite, and round, hard nodules on the neck, head, legs, and other body parts; conjunctival/nasal discharge, drooling, and leg swelling may also occur, with weakness and decreased milk production in severe cases. Diagnosis relies on clinical signs, with laboratory confirmation if needed. If LSD is suspected, isolate the affected animal, maintain clean stalls, and implement vector control. Vaccination may be possible under a veterinarian’s guidance to help prevent future outbreaks.

triage.triage_reason: 家畜の感染症に関する獣医師への一般的な啓発・予防情報であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の影響や異常な流行拡大を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 動物感染症（牛・水牛のランピースキン病）に関する予防啓発記事であり、人獣共通感染症としてのヒト感染リスクの言及はない。対象国リストはヒト感染症のためのものであり、本イベントは動物疾患のため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Empat penduduk dijangkiti antraks selepas makan daging kambing mati mengejut
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four residents infected with anthrax after eating meat from a goat that died suddenly.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax outbreak in Dadapayu, Semanu, Gunungkidul Regency, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, after four residents were confirmed infected from eating meat of a goat that died suddenly. Health authorities said initial detection occurred in early September when patients presented with clinical symptoms of anthrax. Seven individuals were identified as suspected cases; PCR testing confirmed four positives for Bacillus anthracis. Contact tracing found 47 people at risk due to exposure to the goat. Environmental sampling at the slaughter site detected soil contaminated with anthrax blood residues, with decontamination ongoing. Officials condemn the brandu practice of slaughtering and consuming animals that die suddenly, and encourage reporting of sick or dead livestock for safe disposal with compensation available from local government. Public health and veterinary authorities are coordinating to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 死んだヤギの肉を食べた後、4人の住民が炭疽菌に感染
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの既知の炭疽菌流行地域での限定的なアウトブレイクで、人-人感染リスクは低いが、接触者47名への曝露や環境汚染対応が継続中のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 炭疽菌は動物由来で人-人感染はしないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地元当局による環境除染と接触者追跡が進行中であり、追加症例の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 遼寧一家三口食炒蛋中毒　涉保存前水洗加速變質 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Liaoning family of three poisoned after eating scrambled eggs; washing with water before storage accelerates spoilage.
article.articleSummary: Three members of a Liaoning family in Shenyang fell ill after eating scrambled eggs; investigators suspect spoiled eggs as the cause. The eggs had been washed before storage, which experts say can damage the eggshell’s natural protective film and open pores, letting bacteria enter, including Salmonella. Once this protective layer is compromised, spoilage may accelerate, and refrigeration cannot fully eliminate contamination or cross‑infection risk. If eggs have been washed, cook them promptly; for temporary storage, refrigerate immediately and avoid long room‑temperature holding. For shells with light dust, do not wash; wipe with a dry cloth. Heavily soiled shells should be avoided at purchase. Four storage tips: never freeze eggs; do not wash; avoid mixing with other foods; keep the large end up to preserve the air cell. (Source: Dahe News report; published 2026-10-04)

triage.headline_ja: 遼寧一家三口食炒蛋中毒　涉保存前水洗加速變質
triage.triage_reason: 家庭内での単発の食中毒事例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 家族3人の個別食中毒事例であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての集団発生や病原体の広域拡散は確認されていない。疾患名にTyphoid/Paratyphoidが付与されているが記事内容はサルモネラ汚染卵による家庭内食中毒であり、腸チフス・パラチフスとの直接関連は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Sablayan tightens ban on live pig entry amid ASF threat
article.articleSummary: ASF outbreak threat prompts Sablayan, Occidental Mindoro, to strengthen a ban on live pig movement into Sablayan and Occidental Mindoro. On Oct. 3, authorities intercepted pig transporters in Barangay Burgos for allegedly violating Executive Order No. 63-B regulating movement of live pigs, a biosecurity measure to safeguard more than 6,006 hogs. The local government warned that unauthorized entry could incur penalties and legal action and urged cooperation to uphold biosecurity and prevent ASF spread. ASF is a highly contagious viral disease affecting domestic and wild pigs but not humans; outbreaks damage livelihoods and disrupt pork supplies. The crackdown underscores ongoing vigilance against ASF in the area, with authorities enforcing movement controls to protect local hog raisers and food security.

triage.triage_reason: ASFは動物疾病でヒトに感染しないため公衆衛生上の深刻な影響はなく、地域的な家畜移動規制の強化に関する内容で国際的拡大リスクや社会的関心の高まりも確認されない。
triage.notes: ASFは豚のみに感染する動物疾病でヒトへの感染性はなく、本記事は地方自治体の家畜移動規制強化に関する内容。公衆衛生リスクとしての重大性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A di Tangerang Melonjak hingga 30.000, Ini Penyebabnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases in Tangerang surge to 30,000; Here's the cause.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases in Kabupaten Tangerang, Banten Province, Indonesia have risen to 30,000 from January–September 2026. Hendra Tarmizi, head of the Tangerang Health Department, cites extreme weather and dust from a prolonged dry season as drivers. Monthly cases rose from 20,000–25,000 to nearly 28,000–30,000; August–September added about 5,000 per month. Transmission is rapid via close contact and droplets, akin to COVID-19. Some facilities have not conducted laboratory tests to detect influenza A subtypes. Most acute respiratory infections are caused by influenza viruses. The surge spans all age groups and affects 29 districts. Generally not dangerous, but risks are higher for young children and adults with asthma or bronchitis. Prevention emphasizes maintaining immunity and reducing close contact with patients.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospitals hit by medicine shortages as poor patients struggle; 35 dengue cases confirmed; 125 people included in the list of suspected cases; today 39 more influenza cases reported, triggering major concern across the state; even as crises mount, the health minister says none of this will affect us; with a peculiar argument from K. Muraleedharan.
article.articleSummary: Kerala, India: As of Oct 4, 2026, influenza and Fifth disease outbreaks intensify amid acute medicine shortages. The state reports 39 more laboratory-confirmed influenza cases today and 5 confirmed Fifth disease cases, with 58 influenza patients treated yesterday. Dengue remains a major burden with 35 confirmed cases and 125 people on the suspected list. This year’s influenza deaths total 120 (vs 40 in the same period last year); dengue deaths rise to 43 (from 33). Fifth disease cases have surged from 18 by October last year to 477 confirmed this October. Health Minister K. Muraleedharan claims there is no outbreak, contradicting official dashboards showing rising numbers and accountability gaps among district medical officers. Medicine shortages persist, including doxycycline capsules for leptospirosis prophylaxis; an emergency board meeting approved a re-tender for supplies to address stockouts in KMSCL storage facilities.

article.articleHeadline: Biến chứng não hoại tử khi trẻ mắc cúm A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Necrotizing Encephalopathy as a Complication in Children with Influenza A
article.articleSummary: Acute necrotizing encephalopathy (ANE) can complicate Influenza A in children, evidenced by a case at Vietnam’s National Children's Hospital where a previously healthy 4-year-old girl developed fever and cough, then rapidly progressed to coma and death within two days despite intensive care. ANE is a rare but severe neurologic complication of influenza, with mortality around 30–40% and many survivors with neurologic deficits. A leading hypothesis attributes an excessive immune response after viral infection, damaging the blood-brain barrier and causing edema and tissue injury; direct viral destruction remains unproven. Early warning signs include lethargy, disorientation, behavioral changes, seizures, limb weakness, or gait instability; urgent hospital evaluation is essential. Flu vaccination reduces infection, hospitalization, and severe complications. Vaccines cover A/H1N1, A/H3N2, and circulating influenza B strains, with dosing starting at 6 months; children 6 months–9 years may need two doses if not fully vaccinated, otherwise annual boosters. Seek care for respiratory or neuro symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAの合併症としての壊死性脳症（小児例）

article.articleHeadline: Dog lick causes fatal rabies case; experts warn of risks
article.articleSummary: Rabies caused the fatal outcome of a 46-year-old man from Challakere, Karnataka, after a stray dog licked his face while he slept in a field. He had not received anti-rabies vaccination. The exposure is categorized as Category 3 (serious) when saliva contacts broken skin or mucous membranes; rabies virus is shed in saliva and enters via mucous membranes or broken skin, not through intact skin. The patient reportedly scratched his finger while chasing the dog, developed symptoms on Sept 8, was admitted to Chitradurga Medical Institute, and was then transferred to Epidemic Disease Control Hospital (EDH) in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, on Sept 11, dying on Sept 12. There is no cure once rabies symptoms appear. Experts Dr Reeta Mani and Dr Anil Kumar Banagar stress prevention, including vaccination and caution around dog exposures; even a one-day-old puppy can harbour rabies."}{

triage.headline_ja: 犬に顔を舐められたことが原因で致死的な狂犬病感染例が発生；専門家がリスクを警告

article.articleHeadline: Macrolide-Resistant Mycoplasma pneumoniae Found in Nearly One in Five
article.articleSummary: Singapore's nationwide surveillance of Mycoplasma pneumoniae in children (Jan–Apr 2024) genotyped 412 cases (275 hospitalized, 137 community; ages 0–16). MRMP was found in 16.7% of hospitalized and 19.7% of community cases. The resistance arises from the A2063G mutation in the 23S rRNA gene, reducing macrolide binding. Singapore’s MRMP rate is intermediate compared with China, Japan, and South Korea, where paediatric rates exceed 80–90%. Travel in MRMP cases was associated with recent overseas exposure (odds ratio 2.28). Clinically, MRMP infections were linked to longer fever by 2.24 days and longer hospitalization by 0.94 days, but showed no evidence of greater disease severity beyond these duration measures. The findings underscore the need for periodic surveillance to detect upward shifts in resistance amid continued macrolide use for community-acquired pneumonia in children.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポールの小児の約5人に1人でマクロライド耐性マイコプラズマ肺炎菌が検出
triage.triage_reason: 小児肺炎におけるマクロライド耐性率のサーベイランス結果であり、重篤度上昇の明確な証拠はないが、耐性菌の拡大動向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はシンガポールにおけるMRMPサーベイランス調査であるが、シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国・日本・韓国は比較対象として言及されているのみで、本記事の主な発生地域ではないが、中国は対象国リストに含まれるため参考情報として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ketika Anak Terkena Influenza, Ini Kemudian yang Saya Pelajari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: When a Child Contracts Influenza, This Is What I Learned Next.
article.articleSummary: Influenza illness clusters in a male dormitory at an Indonesian middle school (asrama putra), affecting around 75 boys with tens experiencing influenza-like symptoms over the past week. Common symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat, fatigue, headaches, and a bitter taste on eating; several students were asymptomatic. The female dormitory (asrama putri) reported no comparable cases. Most affected students were sent home to rest, and many are reported to be recovering; no deaths or progression to severe illness are described. The author questions whether this is a coincidental influenza surge or a transmission issue in crowded, mobile environments with weekly gatherings, noting potential factors such as changing weather. No laboratory confirmation or clear infection source is provided; the author emphasizes seeking reliable health information rather than drawing conclusions.

triage.headline_ja: 子供がインフルエンザにかかった時、私が学んだこと

article.articleHeadline: 颱風後生飲山泉水　陸男重症感染「多器官受損」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drinking raw mountain spring water after the typhoon — Mr. Lu develops a severe infection with multi-organ damage.
article.articleSummary: China's mainland reports a single, laboratory-confirmed case of leptospirosis after drinking raw mountain spring water following a typhoon. A 61-year-old man with a habit of consuming spring water drank unboiled water despite rain- and flood-related contamination. He initially experienced chest tightness, fatigue, and upper abdominal pain, but rapidly developed septicemia with septic shock and severe cardiac and renal impairment. Hospital tests confirmed Leptospira infection; the patient was categorized as critically ill with multi-organ dysfunction. Through intensive treatment, the infection was brought under control and organ function progressively recovered, and he survived. The report highlights post‑typhoon water contamination risks and cautions against consuming untreated surface water; boiling or proper treatment is recommended to prevent leptospirosis.

triage.headline_ja: 台風後に山の湧き水を生飲みした男性が重症感染「多臓器障害」
triage.triage_reason: 単発の孤発例であり、人-人感染のリスクもなく国際的拡大の懸念は低いため、現時点でピックアップ基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 単発症例報告。台風後の汚染水摂取によるレプトスピラ症であり、環境衛生上の注意喚起記事。アウトブレイクの兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: KMCH Sempora observes World Rabies Day
article.articleSummary: Rabies, spotlighted in Srinagar as Kashmir Medical College and Hospital (KMCH) Sempora marked World Rabies Day on Oct 3, 2026, in an awareness and academic programme. The event, led by KMCH Managing Director Tausif Ahmad and Executive Director Insha Qazi, with KMCH Principal Prof. Nazir Ahmad Khan and Community Medicine faculty, underscored rabies as preventable yet fatal. Speakers stressed immediate wound washing, timely vaccination, and post-exposure prophylaxis after animal bites, and highlighted a One Health approach integrating healthcare, veterinary and community sectors to eliminate rabies. The programme featured scientific presentations and an interactive rabies quiz, concluding with a public health message: Don't wait after a bite. Seek medical care and complete vaccination; rabies is preventable and every life matters. No case counts or lab-confirmation details were provided in the report. Location: Srinagar, Kashmir; event date: Oct 3, 2026 (published Oct 4).

article.articleHeadline: Jangan Panik! Begini Pertolongan Pertama jika Digigit Hewan Penular Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't Panic! Here's How to Provide First Aid If Bitten by a Rabies-Transmitting Animal.
article.articleSummary: Rabies-transmitting animal bites require immediate action. In Jakarta, bites from suspected rabid animals should not cause panic but prompt first aid and urgent medical care. First aid: rinse the wound under running water with soap; if possible, remove as much blood as feasible and clean with antiseptic to reduce viral entry. Then seek medical attention promptly, because rabies has no effective cure once clinical symptoms appear. Anti-rabies vaccine (VAR) is commonly given, and, based on medical assessment, rabies serum (SAR) may be administered to help neutralize the virus. The vaccine typically takes about one to two weeks to stimulate antibody production. The incubation period in humans averages two to three months and can extend up to a year or longer, so actions must not be delayed. Jakarta facilities offering VAR/SAR include RSPI Prof. Dr. Sulianti Saroso and RSUD Tarakan; verify vaccine/serum availability before visiting.

triage.headline_ja: パニックにならないで！狂犬病媒介動物に噛まれた場合の応急処置方法

article.articleHeadline: 颱風後1口山泉水險送命！　61歲男感染休克「心腎重創」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One sip of mountain spring water after the typhoon nearly cost him his life! A 61-year-old man develops septic shock with severe heart and kidney damage.
article.articleSummary: Mainland China: a 61-year-old man, habitually drinking untreated mountain spring water, developed leptospirosis with septic shock after a typhoon and heavy rain contaminated water sources. Despite family warnings to boil water, he drank unboiled spring water. Early symptoms: chest tightness, fatigue, and upper abdominal pain; within days he progressed to severe sepsis with hypotension and major cardiac and renal impairment. Laboratory tests confirmed Leptospira infection. Despite the life-threatening condition, aggressive treatment controlled the infection and he recovered. Leptospira is shed in urine of infected animals and can contaminate water or soil; after storms, floodwaters and sewage may mix with natural water, making seemingly clear springs unsafe. Physicians caution that natural mountain spring water is not automatically safe post-disaster; avoid unprocessed water and seek medical care if fever, fatigue, or muscle pains after exposure.

article.articleHeadline: Flydubai, Tennessee et peste : les informations de la nuit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flydubai, Tennessee and plague: the night’s news.
article.articleSummary: 28-year-old woman dies Oct 1 in Russia's Irkutsk region from pneumonic plague; hospital placed in quarantine; origin of infection unknown, with reports of possible travel to Thailand; patient reportedly worked as a laboratory technician at an Irkutsk plague research institute. Pneumonic plague is the more severe and highly contagious form of plague, distinct from bubonic plague. Last known plague case in Russia was in 2016; a vaccine exists. Meduza notes global plague totals of 3,248 cases and 584 deaths worldwide between 2010 and 2015. The report underscores ongoing surveillance and infection control, awaiting confirmation of transmission route and potential exposure sources. No further details on additional cases or outbreaks are provided.

article.articleHeadline: Đà Nẵng ghi nhận 2 ca sốt rét ngoại lai từ châu Phi chỉ trong 3 ngày
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Da Nang records two imported malaria cases from Africa in just three days.
article.articleSummary: Two more imported malaria cases in Da Nang within three days, from Nigeria and Ivory Coast, bringing 2026’s imported malaria total to four. All four infections are Plasmodium falciparum. The latest cases (Sept 29–Oct 1) are being treated at Da Nang General Hospital; one patient had resided in Nigeria, the other returned from Ivory Coast. P. falciparum malaria can be severe if not promptly diagnosed and treated. Da Nang CDC urges heightened surveillance, rapid testing of febrile patients, especially travelers from malaria-endemic Africa, and prompt reporting of suspected cases. In dengue, Da Nang reports 4,251 dengue cases in the first nine months of 2026, up 2.4-fold from 2025. About 70% of 56 tested samples were dengue virus type 2. Vector-control measures continue, with surveillance of Aedes, source reduction, sanitation, and targeted spraying as warm weather sustains breeding. Residents should inspect homes/workplaces 10–15 minutes daily and seek care for sudden high fever.

triage.headline_ja: ダナンで3日間にアフリカ由来の輸入マラリア症例が2件確認
triage.triage_reason: ダナンでの輸入マラリア症例増加とデング熱の前年比2.4倍という顕著な増加があり、WPRO基準（重症度・流行しやすさ等）に複数該当し、地元保健当局の注意喚起（社会的関心）も確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム・ダナン市における輸入マラリア（ナイジェリア・コートジボワール由来）とデング熱（2026年の累計4,251例、前年比2.4倍）の両方を報告。ナイジェリア・コートジボワールは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはベトナムのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: ನಾಯಿಯೆಂದು ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷ್ಯಿಸಬೇಡಿ: ರೇಬಿಸ್ ವೈರಸ್ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಜ್ಞರಿಂದ ಗಂಭೀರ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't ignore the dog: experts issue a serious warning about the rabies virus.
article.articleSummary: Rabies warning issued in Bengaluru after a fatal case in Karnataka. A 46-year-old man from Challakere, in Chitradurga district, contracted rabies following a street dog bite; the dog’s saliva came into contact with his finger during an attempt to ward it away. Experts note that dog saliva can carry the rabies virus and can enter the body through bites or contact with mucous membranes or broken skin, while intact skin is typically a barrier. He developed rabies symptoms by September 8, was admitted to Challakere-based medical facilities, and was later transported to Indiranagar’s Epidemic Diseases Control Hospital. He died on September 12. Bengaluru doctors warn that once symptoms appear, rabies is almost always fatal despite modern medicine. The article stresses not ignoring dog exposure and the serious risk, urging prompt caution and preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: 犬を軽視するな：狂犬病ウイルスに関する専門家からの深刻な警告
triage.triage_reason: インドでは狂犬病は地域流行病であり、単発の死亡例報告であって国際的拡大や異常性は認められず、既知のリスクに関する注意喚起記事であるため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドで流行性のある既知の人獣共通感染症であり、単発の死亡例報告（1例）で、専門家による予防啓発を目的とした記事。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性はなく、国際的な拡大リスクも想定されない。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết phủ rộng TPHCM, Đồng Nai, 7 người tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Widespread dengue fever in Ho Chi Minh City and Dong Nai Province; seven dead.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is spreading in Ho Chi Minh City (Vietnam) and Dong Nai Province. Ho Chi Minh City has recorded over 35,000 cases this year, with more than 1,400 new cases in the week of September 21–27; a September fatality (a 20-year-old) occurred at the Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases. Dong Nai reports about 15,900 cases to date, including 730 in the latest week (315 under 15) and seven deaths. All four dengue serotypes (D1–D4) are circulating in Dong Nai. Authorities warn of rising risk as the rainy season peaks, expanding vector control with wide-area insecticide spraying and mobilizing personnel and equipment for 253 outbreak sites. High-risk groups include young children, pregnant women, and the elderly; vigilance is urged for deterioration around days 3–7 of illness.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市とドンナイ省でデング熱が拡大、7人死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム南部で季節性デング熱が拡大し死者も出ているが、毎年発生する風土病であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、フルRRAよりも経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで毎年雨季に流行する風土病であり、現地当局が自力でベクター対策を実施中。国際的な支援要請や渡航制限の兆候はないが、症例数・死者数の増加傾向は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Peste, un caso in Siberia: morto in poche ore
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague, a case in Siberia: died within a few hours.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague cases recurred in Siberia, Russia, where a ~28-year-old woman, Daria Shipilova of the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute, died around Oct 1–2, 2026 in Shelekhov; about 200 close contacts were monitored, with early laboratory results negative and an exact exposure source (including a suspected vial incident) not yet confirmed. Yersinia pestis remains circulating in wildlife–flea cycles and can cause rapid, fatal pneumonia when it reaches the lungs. In the United States, the CDC documented a July 2025 pneumonic plague death in Arizona, reported Oct 1, 2026, with abdominal and chest pain, dry cough, pneumonia, no fever or buboes initially, and death within eight hours of hospital admission; exposure to two ill cats suspected; 46 contacts received antibiotic prophylaxis, none developed disease. Other episodes: June 2026 in New Mexico (first human case of the year), Oregon 2024 linked to a cat. Global context (2019–2025): 3,860 suspected, 2,646 confirmed cases across six countries (DR Congo, Madagascar, Kenya, Uganda, China, Mongolia); Congo and Madagascar account for ~98% of confirmed cases; Madagascar shows seasonality. US averages ~7 cases/year, mostly bubonic; Madagascar experienced a major outbreak in 2017.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト、シベリアで1例：数時間で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる急速な死亡例がロシア（シベリア）で発生し、米国でも複数の死亡例が報告されており、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性がある重篤な感染症であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（シベリア、イルクーツク州）および米国（アリゾナ、ニューメキシコ、オレゴン）での肺ペスト事例。DRC・マダガスカル・ケニア・ウガンダ・中国・モンゴルは2019-2025年の世界的な統計的背景情報として言及されているのみで、本記事の主な発生地ではないため、対象国リストに該当する国はverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Winter aespa didiagnosis cacar ular, apa itu herpes zoster?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aespa's Winter diagnosed with shingles; what is herpes zoster?
article.articleSummary: Winter of aespa was diagnosed with herpes zoster (shingles) in Jakarta after hospital evaluation for persistent illness following the group’s September 26, 2026 Miami performance. Herpes zoster results from reactivation of the varicella-zoster virus (the chickenpox virus). Symptoms typically begin with pain, itching, or numbness on one side, followed by a vesicular rash that may crust; fever, headache, and fatigue may occur. The virus is not directly contagious as zoster, but fluid from blisters can transmit varicella-zoster to those who have never had chickenpox or been vaccinated, who may develop chickenpox. Treatment uses antiviral drugs such as acyclovir, valacyclovir, or famciclovir, ideally started within 72 hours of rash onset. Winter canceled the Dallas concert on Sept 29 to prioritise recovery; other aespa members continued. Complications can include postherpetic neuralgia and ocular involvement if the eye is affected. Vaccination, including recombinant zoster vaccines, is a preventive option; WHO 2025 urged considering it for older adults and those with chronic conditions.

triage.headline_ja: aespaのWinter、帯状疱疹（ヘルペス・ゾスター）と診断される、とは何か
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の帯状疱疹（既感染ウイルスの再活性化）に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ mắc RSV, cúm mùa gia tăng khi giao mùa: Cảnh giác dấu hiệu suy hô hấp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Children with RSV and seasonal flu on the rise as the seasons change: Watch for signs of respiratory distress.
article.articleSummary: A 19‑month‑old girl in Hanoi, Vietnam, was diagnosed with acute bronchiolitis due to respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and acute rhinitis/pharyngitis after presenting with fever (up to 39°C), cough, runny nose, and progressive tachypnea. On examination, rapid breathing (60 breaths/min), chest wall retractions, and bilateral coarse crackles were noted; a rapid respiratory panel tested positive for five pathogens; chest X-ray showed bronchial thickening in both lungs; endoscopy revealed mucus pooling and reddened pharyngeal mucosa. The child was treated as an outpatient with a planned follow-up. The report underscores that RSV, a leading bronchiolitis cause (roughly 70–80% of cases), can progress from mild upper symptoms to lower respiratory tract involvement and, in severe cases, pneumonia or respiratory failure. Signs of danger include rapid breathing, chest retractions, nasal flaring, grunting, cyanosis, dehydration, or poor feeding. Prevention highlights: influenza vaccination for children ≥6 months; RSV prophylaxis vaccines may be available for certain groups, including maternal vaccination. Published 2026-10-04.

triage.headline_ja: RSVとインフルエンザの小児患者が季節の変わり目に増加：呼吸窮迫の兆候に注意

article.articleHeadline: Kemkes Kongo: Kasus Ebola turun setelah puncak pada Juli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo's Ministry of Health: Ebola cases fall after peak in July.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows cases falling after a July peak. Health authorities report an overall downward trend, with no new cases in 19 of 63 health zones for 21 consecutive days. The outbreak has killed more than 4,000 people in the DRC, according to INSP. By the end of September, Africa CDC warned the virus remains a cross-border threat as it continues to spread across the country. The report notes uneven progress across zones, with transmission still ongoing in multiple areas and continued risk to neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国保健省:7月のピーク後、エボラ症例数が減少
triage.triage_reason: 致死者4000人超の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、Africa CDCが越境リスクを警告しており、IHR基準複数該当のためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 症例数は減少傾向にあるが、依然として複数の保健地域で感染伝播が継続しており、Africa CDCが近隣国への越境リスクを警告している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Ebola di Kongo turun setelah puncak pada Juli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Kongo fell after peaking in July.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have declined after peaking in July, according to the Ministry of Health. Data show an overall downward trend since late July, with 19 of 63 affected medical zones reporting no new cases for 21 consecutive days. By late September, INSP reported Ebola fatalities surpassing 4,000 nationwide. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya warned the virus remains a threat to neighboring countries as it continues to spread across the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The ministry’s update and figures were cited by Sputnik/RIA Novosti via ANTARA. Published 2026-10-04.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ（DRC）のエボラ出血熱症例、7月のピーク後に減少
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは死者4000人超と深刻で、Africa CDCが近隣国への拡大リスクを警告しておりIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC保健省およびAfrica CDCの情報に基づく既知のエボラアウトブレイクの経過報告。ピーク後の減少傾向を示すが、依然として近隣国への拡大リスクが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Đà Nẵng: Sốt xuất huyết tăng cao, nhiều ca bệnh thuộc tuýp vi rút nguy hiểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Da Nang: Dengue fever on the rise, many cases caused by a dangerous viral serotype.
article.articleSummary: Da Nang reports 4,251 dengue cases as of Oct 1, 2026, up 2.4-fold from the same period in 2025, with 283 outbreak clusters and a weekly average near 350 cases. Laboratory findings from the past 9 months show 39 of 56 virus isolates positive for dengue serotype D2, a dangerous strain associated with severe illness and fatalities. In response to the rising outbreak amid the Central Vietnam rainy season, the city’s CDC is enhancing surveillance and outbreak control, including monitoring single cases and small clusters, and intensifying vector control and larval source reduction. District-level inspections are planned through Oct 7 in Ngũ Hành Sơn, Sơn Trà, Hòa Khánh, An Khê, Khâm Đức, Thạnh Mỹ, Đại Lộc and Điện Bàn Bắc. Public health guidance emphasizes eliminating standing water, covering containers, and seeking medical care for sudden high fever rather than home treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ダナン：デング熱急増、多くの症例が危険なウイルス型に起因
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例が前年同期比2.4倍に増加し、危険なD2型が多く検出されているが、対応は地域CDCレベルで完結しており国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は見られないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: ダナン市CDCがベクター対策・監視強化を実施中であり、現時点では地域内で管理可能な季節性デング熱流行と見られる。危険なD2型の拡大状況は今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Kemkes Kongo: Kasus Ebola turun setelah puncak pada Juli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo's Ministry of Health: Ebola cases fall after peaking in July.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows a downward trend after peaking in July, according to the Ministry of Health. Data indicate overall case declines with 19 of 63 affected medical zones reporting no new Ebola cases for 21 consecutive days. By late September, INSP said the outbreak had killed more than 4,000 people in the country. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya warned that the virus continues to threaten neighboring countries as it spreads across the region. The article notes ongoing transmission within DR Congo and concerns about cross-border spread as the outbreak persists in several zones of the country. Published Oct 4, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国保健省：7月のピーク後、エボラ症例数は減少
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死者4000人超）が継続中で、国境を越えた拡大懸念もAfrica CDCにより指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Africa CDCディレクターが近隣国への感染拡大リスクに言及しているが、具体的な越境感染の確定例は記載なし。症例は減少傾向にあるが、依然として複数の地域で感染が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: தினமும் 200 பாதிப்பு.. தமிழகத்தில் டெங்கு முழுமையாக கட்டுக்குள் உள்ளது - சுகாதாரத் துறை இயக்குனர்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 200 cases per day... Dengue is completely under control in Tamil Nadu - Health Department Director
article.articleSummary: As of October 4, 2026, Tamil Nadu reports about 200 dengue cases daily, with authorities stating dengue outbreaks are fully under control and cases are likely to fall further in the next 15 days. Health Department Director Dr. Somusundaram conducted field inspections in Nagai Tata Nagar, Nagoor Samba Thottam, and Sunami Housing Colony, reviewing larval source elimination and fogging operations. He visited a dengue-affected child in Southern Poiykainallur and assessed ongoing prevention measures there. He then reviewed fever and dengue wards, blood testing facilities, and medicine stocks at Arathur Government Medical College Hospital and Velankanni Government Primary Health Centre. He highlighted a cross-departmental, June-initiated drive to curb dengue, chikungunya, malaria, and typhoid ahead of the northeast monsoon, noting fewer dengue cases and deaths this year. Stocks include Oseltamivir for flu-like illness, IV fluids, ORS, mosquito coils and repellents, doxycycline, and Demibas larvicide.

triage.headline_ja: 毎日200件の感染…タミル・ナードゥ州ではデング熱は完全に制御下にある－保健局長
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当局により「完全に制御下」と発表され、症例数も今後減少見込みであり、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内であるため、異常性・社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性デング熱対策の進捗報告であり、保健局による定例的な視察・在庫確認活動を伝えるもの。症例数は減少傾向にあり、国際的拡大やアウトブレイクの異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: La France réaffirme son soutien à la RDC pour mettre fin à l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: France Reaffirms Its Support for the DRC to End the Epidemic
article.articleSummary: France pledges further support to the Democratic Republic of Congo to end the Ebola outbreak. On October 3 in Bunia, Ituri province, French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot reaffirmed Paris’s commitment to mobilize additional funding to strengthen the response to Ebola, the 17th epidemic now affecting seven provinces with over 8,000 cases. Barrot toured the Rwampara Ebola Treatment Center on Bunia’s southwest outskirts, receiving updates on patient care, surveillance, and prevention. He praised Congolese authorities and health workers and urged sustained actions to prevent resurgence. He noted budget discussions would include humanitarian allocations to finish the fight, underscoring durable international mobilization. Barrot was accompanied by INRB Director-General Jean-Jacques Muyembe, who visited the provincial laboratory housing the Ebola research center, a key node in rapid case identification and epidemiological surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: フランス、エボラ流行終息に向けコンゴ民主共和国への支援を再確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7州・8000例超に拡大中のエボラ第17次流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: フランスは資金・支援国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため、verified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Rabies, PDHI Kalsel Gelar Vaksinasi Hingga Kastrasi Gratis Hewan Peliharaan di Banjarbaru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Prevention: PDHI South Kalimantan Holds Vaccinations and Free Pet Neutering in Banjarbaru
article.articleSummary: On September 4, 2026, Banjarbaru, South Kalimantan, Indonesia, PDHI (Indonesian Veterinary Doctors Association) South Kalimantan held One Health Kalsel 2026 to mark World Rabies Day. The event, at the Lambung Mangkurat Museum area, offered free vaccination for animals that can transmit rabies (dogs, cats, primates, civets and similar) and free neutering for male cats, supported by multiple partners. Organizers deployed about 40 veterinarians, administering up to 1,000 vaccine doses and neutering 40 animals. The program aims to advance rabies prevention and move toward a rabies-free Kalimantan Selatan, contributing to Indonesia’s 2030 target. Rabies is a deadly zoonosis but preventable through mass vaccination. Officials note Kalimantan Selatan is not yet rabies-free, underscoring the need for continued, collaborative vaccination efforts with health and veterinary agencies and sponsors.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病予防：南カリマンタンPDHIがバンジャルバルで無料ワクチン接種と去勢キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は世界狂犬病デーに合わせた予防啓発・ワクチン接種イベントの報告であり、新規症例や異常な流行拡大の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種・去勢キャンペーンの実施報告であり、具体的な感染症例や死亡例の報告はない。南カリマンタンが未だ狂犬病フリー地域でないことへの言及はあるが、これは既知の継続課題であり新規シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: ​台风后生饮山泉水 男子重症感染 多器官受损 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the typhoon, drinking raw mountain spring water: man in critical condition due to infection with multi-organ dysfunction
article.articleSummary: 61-year-old Beijing resident who habitually drank directly from mountain spring water drank untreated water after a recent typhoon. He initially experienced chest tightness, fatigue and upper abdominal pain, attributed to ordinary fatigue, and did not seek immediate medical care; within days his condition deteriorated into severe leptospirosis with septic shock and multi-organ dysfunction, notably affecting the heart and kidneys. Laboratory tests confirmed Leptospira infection. He received intensive care and targeted therapy, with gradual control of infection and recovery of organ function, ultimately surviving. The report warns that post-typhoon floodwaters may contaminate water supplies and advises against drinking untreated surface water; boiling or properly treating water before consumption is recommended. This is a single confirmed Chinese case with no deaths or imported/exported cases reported.

triage.headline_ja: 台風後に山の湧き水を生飲みした男性が重症感染、多臓器障害に
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個人症例であり、人-人感染や公衆衛生上の広範な影響は認められず、台風後の汚染水によるレプトスピラ症は既知のリスクパターンであるため特段の異常性もない。
triage.notes: 本症例は個人の生水摂取習慣による単発感染であり、二次感染や集団発生の報告はない。台風後の水源汚染への注意喚起目的の記事と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ситуация как в Ухане: Кремль пытается скрыть вспышку чумы " Новости Беларуси
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Situation like in Wuhan: the Kremlin tries to cover up a plague outbreak
article.articleSummary: In Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, quarantine measures were imposed after the death of 28-year-old Daria Shipilova, an employee of the anti-plague institute, with nearly 200 people in isolation. Public officials have not named the disease, describing it only as a 'dangerous infection.' Shipilova had traveled near the Russia–Mongolia border and died at Shelekhov District Hospital, which was placed under strict quarantine. In total, at least 189 people are isolated: 114 in one hospital, 63 in another, and 12 at the Anti-Plague Institute. Several of the isolated have shown symptoms. Epidemiologist Mikhail Favorov doubts a lab accident explanation (claims workers in protective gear handle pathogens). He notes the patient may have had breathing failure and that antibacterial therapy could have been started late, after a misdiagnosis as COVID-19. The situation has prompted comparisons to Wuhan’s early outbreak and sparked travel advisories for Baikalsk and Shelekhov, with authorities offering little detail.

triage.headline_ja: ウハンのような状況：クレムリンがペスト流行を隠蔽しようとしている
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で抗疫研究所職員が死亡し約200人が隔離されるなど、感染症の正体が公表されないまま重大な公衆衛生上の懸念が生じており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生国はロシアであり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。ただし疾患名に『Plague』『COVID-19』が挙げられ、情報隠蔽や国境付近での発生などIHR基準に強く合致するため、フルリスク評価への移行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: ไข้หวัดใหญ่ระบาด เด็กเสียชีวิต 1ราย เปิดสัญญาณอันตราย ต้องพาลูกไป รพ.ทันที
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza outbreak: one child dies; warning signs emerge; take your child to the hospital immediately.
article.articleSummary: As of 4 October 2026, influenza outbreak in Nakhon Ratchasima Province, Thailand, with one child death. A 7-year-old child with obesity and no prior conditions died during the outbreak in Korat. A health official warns influenza can trigger severe complications in children, and provides red flags for urgent hospital care: rapid, labored breathing (chest retractions), dehydration (no urine for 8 hours, dry mouth, no tears when crying), altered consciousness (lethargy, unresponsiveness, seizures), severe muscle pains, fever above 40°C that persists after fever-reducing medicine, or fever in infants under 3 months. Warning signs of secondary infection (worsening fever and cough after apparent improvement) also require attention. High-risk groups who should receive antivirals promptly include obesity (BMI ≥95th percentile), young children (under 5, especially under 2), chronic diseases (asthma, COPD, heart, kidney, liver, diabetes, sickle cell), neurological conditions, and immunocompromise (HIV, cancer, steroids). Outbreak ongoing in Nakhon Ratchasima; schools may close after Oct 6.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ流行、子供1人死亡 危険な兆候を解説、直ちに病院へ
triage.triage_reason: タイ・ナコンラチャシマ県での季節性インフルエンザ流行による小児死亡例の報告だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等のIHR基準には該当せず、地域内の学校閉鎖検討など経過観察が必要な段階。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの地域流行で、死亡例1件と学校閉鎖の可能性が報じられているが、季節性疾患として通常の公衆衛生対応範囲内と考えられる。続報（死者数増加や地域拡大）があればPICKUPへの引き上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: Gánh nặng RSV ở trẻ em Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The RSV burden in Vietnamese children.
article.articleSummary: RSV can present like a cold but may rapidly progress to bronchiolitis and respiratory failure in children under 2. At MEDLATEC Tây Hồ in Hanoi, a 19‑month‑old boy (N.P.N.) with fever up to 39°C and cough was diagnosed with RSV‑associated acute bronchiolitis and acute nasopharyngitis after worsening symptoms including productive cough, vomiting after coughing, nasal congestion, and diarrhea. Exam revealed tachypnea, mild chest‑wall retractions, wheeze, and snoring; chest X‑ray showed bronchial lesions. The case underlines RSV’s high transmissibility and potential for quick deterioration in infants. Parents should seek early evaluation for persistent cough, rapid breathing, chest retractions, poor feeding, or lethargy. In Vietnam, RSV leads to tens–hundreds of thousands of hospitalizations annually, with some ICU admissions; prevention emphasizes hygiene and targeted measures such as maternal vaccination or monoclonal antibodies when indicated. Global RSV mortality was about 66,300 under‑1‑year deaths per year (2019).

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの子供におけるRSVの負担
triage.triage_reason: RSVはベトナムで毎年発生する既知の季節性疾患であり、単一症例の啓発記事に過ぎず、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はRSVに関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、単一の重症小児症例を例示しているが、既知の季節性疾患であり新規性・異常性はない。
