article.articleHeadline: Ученые нашли способ заставить вирус гриппа склеиваться
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists have found a way to make the influenza virus stick together.
article.articleSummary: China-based researchers developed a novel anti-influenza approach by coupling several antiviral molecules to a viral-binding protein fragment, forcing influenza virions to clump together. In one configuration, three zanamivir molecules were linked, causing virions to aggregate and reducing both cellular entry and the release of new particles. A second construct, based on peramivir and designated AVCPI-3, showed superior results in mouse experiments. The animals were exposed to diverse influenza strains, including H1N1, H3N2, H5N1, and influenza B. The team suggests that dual-action designs—stronger virion binding and simultaneous disruption of multiple transmission stages—could enhance antiviral effectiveness. The work compares these multi-molecule constructs with standard antiviral drugs, noting improved performance in the AVCPI-3 variant in the mouse model. This approach aims to curb spread by both blocking infection and viral egress.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者たちがインフルエンザウイルスを固まらせる方法を発見
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は中国の研究機関による抗インフルエンザ治療法の開発に関する科学ニュースであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクイベントではなく基礎研究の成果報告である。疾患の発生、流行、患者数増加などの公衆衛生上の懸念事項は記載されていない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはBluedot APIが感染症関連キーワード（H1N1, H3N2, H5N1, インフルエンザB）から自動抽出した研究論文・科学ニュース記事である。実際の感染症の集団発生やアウトブレイクではなく、マウスモデルでの実験結果に基づく治療法開発の報告であるため、EBS活動の対象外と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ghebreyesus: Scaling Up Ebola Response in DRC Is Making Difference
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, with transmission ongoing and new hotspots emerging as of 2026-10-04. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says scaling up the response—more supplies, strengthened logistics, and frontline teams—is improving treatment, surveillance, laboratory services, and infection-prevention in affected communities. In a post on X monitored by the Yemen News Agency (Saba), Ghebreyesus urged sustaining and expanding the response and investing in field capabilities, including increasing health workers, bolstering surveillance, expanding access to care, ensuring safe and dignified burials, and enhancing community engagement. The message underscores that despite gains, the outbreak persists and requires continued international support to curb spread and protect communities.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長:DRCにおけるエボラ対応の拡大が効果を上げている
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続し新たなホットスポットも出現しており、WHOが国際支援の継続拡大を呼びかけている。重篤な公衆衛生リスクかつ国際的拡大・支援の必要性があるためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: イエメンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事はイエメン通信社が配信したものだが、内容の主題はDRCのエボラ対応。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola franchit le cap des 4000 morts en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has crossed the 4,000-death threshold in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 8,000 confirmed cases and 4,000 deaths, the 17th and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. Mobile laboratories deployed near treatment centers in Ituri and North Kivu enable rapid testing and can be shifted to emerging hotspots, improving patient triage and care; the case fatality rate has hovered around 50% in recent months. The response is hampered by ongoing armed clashes, notably between M23 forces (allegedly supported by Rwanda) and the Congolese regular army, which disrupt access and humanitarian aid. The United Nations warns of heightened risk after a medical center at the Kikong internally displaced persons site in Ituri was burned, with violence, displacement, and threats impeding the outbreak response. The report provides no details on infection source or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、8000例超・4000人超の死者を伴う大規模流行で、武力衝突により対応が妨げられており国際的拡大・対応支援の必要性が高いためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ルワンダは武装勢力支援疑惑の文脈で言及されているのみで、感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Health Wrap Episode 53 discuss cancer drug pricing, medicine misuse and dengue
article.articleSummary: Health Wrap Episode 53 reports on cancer drug pricing and dengue surveillance. The Supreme Court questioned the price gap between supply price and maximum retail price for essential cancer medicines; an example showed a drug priced ₹2,700 to retailers and ₹27,000 as MRP, described as 'broad daylight dacoity.' The discussion covers hospital-pharmacy sales, a proposed uniform 16% margin, generic prescriptions, and the Drugs Prices Control Order. It also cautions against indiscriminate painkiller and antibiotic use due to kidney disease and antimicrobial resistance, urging prudent prescribing. The Dengue Early Warning System, developed by the Institute of Advanced Virology in Keralam, fuses surveillance data with rainfall, temperature, and humidity to generate weekly district-level forecasts via machine learning; trained on six years of data (Mar 2020–Feb 2026), it could ease surveillance, vector-control, preparedness, and public alerts if validated. Episode ends with a note on dengue mosquito eggs' dormancy in dry conditions.

triage.headline_ja: ヘルスラップ エピソード53：がん治療薬の価格設定、薬の誤用、デング熱について議論
triage.triage_reason: 記事はデング熱早期警戒システムの技術開発やがん治療薬の価格問題を扱う一般的な医療ニュース・ポッドキャストであり、具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事はケララ州で開発中のデング熱早期警戒システム（機械学習による予測モデル）に関する技術紹介であり、実際の流行・症例報告ではないため、具体的な発生地域としては挙げない。

article.articleHeadline: وفيات إيبولا تتجاوز 4 آلاف في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths surpass 4,000 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Health Ministry reports 4,018 Ebola-related deaths and 8,300 confirmed infections across seven provinces, with 2,162 recoveries, yielding a case-fatality rate of 48.4%. The outbreak remains active, with latest data reflecting ongoing transmission in affected regions. Ebola is a severe hemorrhagic fever first identified in 1976 in simultaneous outbreaks in Sudan and the Democratic Republic of the Congo and named after the nearby Ebola River. In May 2026 authorities detected a new flare in Ituri province in the eastern part of the country, associated with a Bundibugyo strain, a variant for which no vaccines or approved treatments exist at present, complicating containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,300人感染、致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行が継続中。ワクチン未承認の新変異株（ブンディブギョ株）による流行拡大で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSudanが含まれるが、記事はエボラの歴史的起源（1976年）として言及しているのみで、現行の流行はDRC国内（イトゥリ州含む7州）に限定されるためSudanは除外。

article.articleHeadline: Clustered Hepatitis A cases hit several Valencia City barangays
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A cluster detected in Valencia City, Bukidnon. As of 2026-10-04, six patients are hospitalized, with five of them neighbors in Barangay Lurugan; nine individuals have sought medical care for symptoms such as yellowing eyes or skin across Barangays Lurugan, Poblacion, and Kahaponan. Investigations by the City Health Office and the Epidemiology, Disease Surveillance, and Research Division point to local barangay water systems as the likely infection source, while ruling out street-food or commercial-food exposures. Environmental Sanitation Division teams are conducting water sampling in affected puroks; laboratory results are pending. No fatalities reported. Officials describe the situation as a cluster rather than an outbreak, and are coordinating with regional sanitation and education authorities while urging community vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: バレンシア市内の複数バランガイでA型肝炎のクラスターが発生
triage.triage_reason: 小規模なクラスター（入院6名、死亡なし）で、水系感染が疑われるが検査結果待ちであり、地域保健当局が国内対応中のため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 水道水汚染が疑われ、ラボ結果待ち。当局は『クラスター』であり『アウトブレイク』ではないと説明。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Erion Dasho raises the alarm over salmonella: Be careful with chicken, eggs, fruit and vegetables
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-04, Albanian physician Erion Dasho warns that Salmonella risk is spreading in Albania, detailing transmission routes and preventive measures. He emphasizes hygiene in the food-service sector as the primary defense, calling for mandatory handwashing training for staff, including foreign workers from Asia such as India. Poultry meat, especially chicken, and eggs are identified as high-risk if not cooked thoroughly; many restaurants have removed raw eggs from recipes to reduce contamination. The risk may also affect fruit and leafy vegetables, which can be contaminated via organic fertilizer, so careful washing and cleaning before consumption is advised. The briefing does not report specific case counts or outbreaks, but underscores proper cooking, hygiene, and worker training to curb Salmonella spread in Albania.

triage.headline_ja: エリオン・ダショ医師がサルモネラ菌への警鐘を鳴らす：鶏肉・卵・果物・野菜に注意
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの報告はなく、医師による一般的な衛生啓発記事であり、対象国（インド）での実際の発生事実も確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はアルバニア国内の食品衛生に関する注意喚起であり、インドはアジアからの外国人労働者の例として言及されているのみで、インドでの発生事実は記載されていない。アルバニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: 3歲女童狂吐10多次送急診！　台中火雞肉飯爆8人不適急停業
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 3-year-old girl vomiting more than 10 times, rushed to the ER! Taichung turkey rice shop sickens 8 people, abruptly halts business.
article.articleSummary: Eight people in Taichung City's Beitun District developed GI symptoms after dining at a turkey rice shop on Wenxin Road, Section 4. A 3-year-old girl vomited more than ten times around 3 a.m. after returning home; her white blood cell count rose above 10,000 and she received IV fluids and antiemetics. The Taichung City Food Safety and Sanitation Office is investigating and found hygiene and storage deficiencies at the shop, including refrigerator temperatures not up to standard, ingredients stored off the ground, and absence of an annual health inspection report. The operator has been ordered to halt operations for corrective action and will be reinspected. Laboratory results identifying the pathogen are expected in about two weeks; if a pathogen is detected, penalties range from NT$60,000 to NT$20,000,000 and cases may be prosecuted. Causality between the meals and symptoms is not yet confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: 3歳女児が10回以上嘔吐しER搬送！台中の七面鳥飯店で8人が体調不良、急遽営業停止
triage.triage_reason: 単一飲食店における食中毒疑いの局所的事例であり、病原体も未特定。公衆衛生上の深刻な拡大リスクや国際的関心は認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾（Taiwan）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。地元の食品衛生当局が調査・是正措置を実施中であり、地域単発の食中毒事案と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ mắc RSV, cúm mùa gia tăng khi giao mùa: Cảnh giác dấu hiệu suy hô hấp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Children infected with RSV, seasonal influenza on the rise as the seasons change: Be vigilant for signs of respiratory distress.
article.articleSummary: RSV and seasonal influenza infections rise in children during seasonal change in Hanoi, Vietnam. Medlatec Tay Ho reports a 19‑month‑old, N.P.N., with fever to 39°C, cough, runny nose and dyspnea; exam shows tachycardia 150 bpm, tachypnea 60/min, mild chest indrawing and bilateral rales. A rapid five-pathogen panel was positive; chest X‑ray revealed thickened bronchial walls. Diagnosed with acute bronchiolitis due to respiratory syncytial virus and upper respiratory infection, the child is managed as outpatient with follow-up. RSV is a leading bronchiolitis cause, accounting for about 70–80% of cases; progression to pneumonia or respiratory failure can occur, especially in children under 24 months, including preterm or those with underlying conditions. Influenza can cause fever, cough, vomiting, or poor feeding in kids. Warn signs include rapid breathing, chest indrawing, grunting, cyanosis, dehydration, or lethargy—seek urgent care. Flu vaccine is advised for children aged 6 months and older.

triage.headline_ja: 季節の変わり目にRSVと季節性インフルエンザが増加する子どもたち：呼吸困難の兆候に警戒を
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のRSV・インフルエンザに関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性のRSV・インフルエンザに関する個別症例報告・啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Quezon City Reports Over 1,000 Leptospirosis
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis outbreak in Quezon City, Philippines, with 1,037 cases and 66 deaths reported by the Quezon City Epidemiology and Surveillance Division as of October 4, 2026. Of cases, 68% (approximately 709) are 21 years and older, and 788 are male. District 2 records the highest number of cases (311), followed by District 4 (231) and District 6 (146). In District 2, Commonwealth accounts for 82 cases, Batasan Hills 71, Payatas B 55, and Holy Spirit 40. The advisory urges residents to avoid floodwaters, wear protective gear (boots, gloves), maintain clean surroundings, and seek medical advice after floodwater exposure for possible doxycycline prophylaxis. Ongoing leptospirosis exposure is linked to floodwater contact, highlighting the need for preventive measures in affected districts.

triage.headline_ja: ケソン市でレプトスピラ症が1,000件以上報告
triage.triage_reason: ケソン市で1,037例・66例死亡という大規模なレプトスピラ症アウトブレイクが報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と規模の異常性からIHR基準2項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 洪水曝露が主要な感染経路であり、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクは低いが、死亡者数と症例数の規模が大きく、公衆衛生対応の強化が必要とされる。続報で致死率の推移や対策の効果を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Says Ebola Peak Is Behind It As Outbreak Response Gains Ground
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, persists though Health Minister Roger Samuel Kamba says the peak is behind it as response intensifies. By Sept 30 the outbreak affected seven provinces and 63 health zones, with 7,890 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths as of Sept 23. Sud Ubangi and Haut-Uélé have seen spread, raising cross-border concerns. There is no licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo virus; the Ervebo vaccine is used under research protocols while investigators assess protection against this strain. Authorities emphasize surveillance, rapid detection, contact tracing, treatment, vaccination, and community engagement. South Ubangi demonstrated rapid response, reaching notified areas within two days to provide vaccines, treatment and preventive measures for contacts. After a mid-August peak in Ituri, new infections have declined, but transmission remains elevated. Declared in May, this is DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: DRCはエボラ出血熱のピークは過ぎたと発表、アウトブレイク対応が進展
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7,890例の確定症例、3,799人の死亡という大規模なエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス株）のアウトブレイクが継続しており、国境を越えた拡大懸念とライセンスワクチン不在という異常事態がありIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョウイルス株に対するライセンスワクチンがなく、Erveboワクチンが研究プロトコル下で使用されている点に注意。7州63保健区に拡大、DRC史上17回目のエボラ発生。

article.articleHeadline: 生饮山泉水六旬大伯遭致命感染！医生提醒野外涉水要当心
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man in his sixties contracts a fatal infection after drinking untreated mountain spring water; doctors warn to be careful with outdoor water exposure.
article.articleSummary: Severe leptospirosis from drinking untreated mountain spring water in Hangzhou, China. A 61-year-old man who habitually drank spring water after heavy rains developed septic shock and multi-organ failure. He was transferred to Shulan (Hangzhou) Hospital, where the infectious diseases team provided aggressive sepsis management and organ support. Diagnosis was confirmed by blood high-throughput next-generation sequencing and CDC verification, identifying Leptospira infection. The patient survived after comprehensive treatment. The same hospital treated another Weil's disease leptospiral infection in a different patient, illustrating variable presentation. Leptospirosis is a weather-linked zoonosis common after heavy rain or floods; early symptoms resemble flu but can rapidly progress to liver and kidney failure and diffuse pulmonary hemorrhage with high mortality. Preventive guidance includes boiling or bottled water, avoiding raw water, skin protection, and vaccination of pets; high-risk workers should wear protective gear.

triage.headline_ja: 生水を飲んだ60代男性が致命的な感染症に罹患！医師が野外での水への接触に注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 個人の生活習慣（生水飲用）に起因する単発のレプトスピラ症症例であり、人-人感染や集団発生の兆候はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 個人症例の医療啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや集団発生の報告ではない。重症化事例（敗血症性ショック、多臓器不全）はあるが散発的なもので、注意喚起目的の記事と判断。

article.articleHeadline: O silêncio da Sífilis: o perigo oculto de uma infecção em alta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Silence of Syphilis: The Hidden Danger of a Rising Infection
article.articleSummary: Syphilis, caused by Treponema pallidum, is rising in Brazil, despite being ancient and curable. Transmission is mainly through direct contact with infected lesions during sexual activity, with vertical transmission possible, causing congenital syphilis. Disease stages include primary (painless entry ulcer), secondary (dermatologic lesions, including on the palms and soles), and latent (asymptomatic for weeks to years). Diagnosis uses rapid serology (antibody detection) and VDRL titers; interpretation requires exposure history and clinical context. Testing intervals: highly exposed sexually active individuals every six months; others at least annually. Treatment with benzathine penicillin can cure when properly administered; the number of doses depends on the stage and duration of infection. Untreated syphilis can damage organs and facilitate HIV transmission. Public health measures should expand education, including school programs and prenatal testing to prevent congenital syphilis.

triage.headline_ja: 梅毒の沈黙:増加する感染症の隠れた危険
triage.triage_reason: 梅毒は既知の慢性的な性感染症に関する啓発記事であり、急性の公衆衛生危機や異常な流行を示すものではないため、シグナルとして取り上げる必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は梅毒の病態・診断・治療に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、急増や異常発生を示す具体的データは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Mystery in Siberia: anti-plague lab worker dies after test tube breaks, nearly 200 is
article.articleSummary: Death of Daria Shipilova, 28, in Shelekhov, Siberia, days after an alleged laboratory exposure at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute; officials have not confirmed plague as the cause, though pneumonia developed rapidly and pneumonic plague is suspected. A quarantine is in place: hospital wards restricted, some admissions and discharges halted. About 197 people are identified as potentially exposed, with 189 under observation; officials report no confirmed infections and negative tests, though some conflicting accounts persist. A criminal investigation into safety violations and a rapid public-health response led by Rospotrebnadzor head Anna Popova is underway. Three infection scenarios circulated—lab accident, a work trip to Buryatia, or return from Thailand—but none officially verified. The institute, founded 1934 and operating under Rosptrebnadzor, is tightly controlling information as authorities monitor a “particularly dangerous infection.”

triage.headline_ja: シベリアの謎:抗ペスト研究所職員が試験管破損後に死亡、約200人に影響
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所内での試験管破損後に職員が死亡し、肺ペストが疑われている。約200人が曝露の可能性があり隔離措置が取られていることから、重大性・異常性ともに高く、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 事象はロシア（イルクーツク州・シェレホフ市）で発生しており、対象国リストには含まれない。タイへの渡航歴は感染経路の一つとして噂されているが未確認であり、タイでの発生事実は確認されていないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: חשד למקרה אבולה בישראל: גבר שחזר מקונגו אושפז בשיבא
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Israel: A man who returned from Congo was admitted to Sheba Medical Center.
article.articleSummary: Israel is handling a suspected Ebola case after a man returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo developed fever. The Health Ministry states this is a suspicion as of 2026-10-04, with laboratory confirmation expected later today. The patient has been admitted to Sheba Medical Center and placed in isolation per infection-control procedures. An epidemiological investigation is underway to identify contacts who may have been exposed; individuals not contacted by the Health Ministry are not required to take action. No confirmed case or fatalities have been reported at this time. The infection source is importation from the DRC, with authorities pursuing contact tracing and awaiting test results to determine whether Ebola is confirmed and to guide public health actions.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエルでエボラ感染疑い症例:コンゴから帰国した男性がシバ医療センターに入院
triage.triage_reason: DRC渡航後の発熱でエボラ疑いとして検査中だが、確定診断はまだ出ておらず、感染源国DRCでの流行状況についても言及がないため、続報を待つ必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイスラエル国内での疑い症例（渡航関連）であり、イスラエルは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは感染源として言及されているが、DRC国内でのエボラ流行発生そのものについては記述がないため、verified_locationsには含めなかった。確定診断結果（ラボ確認）の続報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: חשד לאבולה בישראל: אדם ששב מקונגו אושפז בבידוד - כיפה
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola in Israel: A person who returned from Congo was placed in isolation - Kipa.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-04, Israel's Ministry of Health reports a suspected Ebola case in a traveler returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo who developed fever. The patient is in isolation and has been transferred to Sheba Medical Center, designated for suspected high-risk infectious diseases; laboratory tests are being conducted with results expected today. An epidemiological investigation will identify contacts, and those not contacted need not take action. Ebola is not airborne and spreads via direct contact with a symptomatic patient or with blood, body fluids, or secretions. The Ministry outlines preparedness measures: protective equipment, early detection for travelers, and hospital readiness. Travel advisories urge avoiding nonessential trips to the Congo and areas with active outbreaks; travelers returning with fever or symptoms within 21 days should stay home and call the Health Ministry hotline at 5400*, noting exposure. No confirmed Ebola case has been diagnosed in Israel.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエルでエボラ疑い例：コンゴから帰国した人物が隔離入院
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者にエボラ疑い症例が発生し、隔離・検査が行われている。重篤な感染症であり国際的拡大の可能性があるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: イスラエル国内での症例は未確定（疑い例）であり、曝露源であるコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が本質的な感染源と考えられる。イスラエルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。続報での検査結果確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ghebreyesus : L'intensification de la riposte contre 'Ebola' en RDC porte ses fruits
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ghebreyesus: The intensification of the Ebola response in the DRC is bearing fruit.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues with transmission and the emergence of new hotspots. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus states that intensified response is bearing fruit, with new supplies, strengthened logistics, and frontline teams boosting treatment, surveillance, laboratory analyses, and infection prevention in affected communities. While progress is evident, transmission persists and new foci appear, underscoring the need to sustain and broaden the response and invest in on-ground capacity: more health workers, enhanced surveillance, expanded access to care, safe and dignified burials, and stronger community engagement. WHO continues to support the DRC government and partners with technical leadership and logistics to deliver essential supplies. The gains are fragile and not guaranteed; gratitude is extended to all partners aiding supply mobilization and delivery, and to those advancing durable investment, solidarity, and collective action to protect communities and end the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長：コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ対応強化が成果を上げている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続し新たなホットスポットが出現しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当し、WHOによる国際支援も継続している。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長によるエボラ対応の進捗報告だが、伝播継続と新規発生地の出現が明記されており、脆弱な成果である旨も述べられている。既存のアウトブレイクに関する継続報道のため、既にフルRRA対象となっている可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Da Nang sees surge in dengue cases as dangerous virus strain spreads
article.articleSummary: As of 4 October 2026, Da Nang, Vietnam reports a dengue surge with 283 outbreak clusters—nearly fourfold year-on-year—driving about 350 cases per week. While counts slightly declined last week, they remain above the five-year average and the 2025 period. The central region’s rainy season is expected to sustain transmission, prompting intensified surveillance and rapid response to individual cases and small clusters. Laboratory testing shows predominance of the DENV-2 serotype this year: 39 of 56 positive samples (70%) from January–September, a strain associated with higher risk of severe dengue and potentially fatal complications. Preventive efforts focus on eliminating mosquito breeding sites rather than sole reliance on spraying. Ngu Hanh Son Ward mobilized residents for larval source reduction and a second disinfectant spray; an inspection campaign covers eight communes/wards (Ngu Hanh Son, Son Tra, Hoa Khanh, An Khe, Kham Duc, Thanh My, Dai Loc, Dien Ban Bac) through October 7.

triage.headline_ja: ダナンでデング熱症例が急増、危険なウイルス株が拡大
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ダナンでデング熱症例が前年比約4倍に急増し、重症化リスクの高いDENV-2型が優勢だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の明確な兆候はなく、既存の公衆衛生対応で管理されている段階。
triage.notes: デング熱は季節性・地域流行性が高く既知の公衆衛生課題であり、地域当局が対策を主導している。重症化リスクの高いDENV-2優勢という点は注視が必要だが、現時点で国際的シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: חשד לאבולה בישראל: נוסע ששב מקונגו הועבר לבידוד - אמס MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola in Israel: A traveler who returned from Congo was placed in isolation - AMS MS.
article.articleSummary: Israel is monitoring a suspected Ebola case in a traveler who returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo. The individual developed fever after returning to Israel and was transferred to Sheba Medical Center, placed in isolation under established high-risk infection protocols. At this stage, the case is suspected; laboratory testing will be conducted per locally and internationally accepted protocols, with results expected today. An epidemiological investigation to identify contacts will be completed. The Health Ministry emphasizes that Ebola is not airborne and transmission occurs through direct contact with a symptomatic patient or via blood, body fluids, or secretions. There is no confirmed case in Israel as of 04 October 2026. Travelers returning from Congo who develop fever or unusual symptoms within 21 days should stay home, limit contact, and call the Health Hotline *5400. Authorities monitor ongoing Congo Ebola outbreaks and maintain preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエルでエボラ疑い：コンゴから帰国した旅行者が隔離された - AMS MS
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者にエボラ疑い例が発生し、イスラエルで隔離・検査中であり、輸入例としての国際的拡大リスクと異常性が認められるためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題はイスラエル国内における輸入疑い例の監視・隔離対応であり、対象国リストに含まれるコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）は背景情報としてのみ言及されている（進行中のアウトブレイクへの言及）。そのためverified_locationsは空とした。イスラエルでの確定例は本記事時点で報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس خطير يهدد إسرائيل.. تل أبيب تعلن الاشتباه بإصابة شخص بالإيبولا بعد رحلة من الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A dangerous virus threatens Israel... Tel Aviv reports suspected Ebola infection in a person after a trip from the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is suspected in Tel Aviv, Israel, in a person who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and developed fever. The Israeli Ministry of Health emphasizes it remains a suspected case at this stage; no confirmed Ebola case has been reported in Israel. The patient is being treated in isolation under established protocols for highly infectious diseases and has been transferred to Sheba Medical Center, a designated center for suspected EVD. In the prior two months, two other patients were admitted with suspected Ebola but were later ruled out. Authorities continue surveillance and infection-control measures as investigations proceed.

triage.headline_ja: 危険なウイルスがイスラエルを脅かす…テルアビブでコンゴ旅行後にエボラ感染疑いの人物が報告される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者にエボラ疑い例が報告されたが、現時点では未確定であり、過去2件の疑い例も否定された経緯があるため、確定情報を待って経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイスラエル（テルアビブ）における疑い例であり、DRCでの実際の発生・アウトブレイクに関する記述はないため、対象国リストには該当なし。確定診断の有無を継続的に確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: משרד הבריאות מעדכן: דיווח על אדם החשוד כחולה באבולה
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health updates: report of a person suspected of having Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Israel's Ministry of Health reports a single suspected Ebola case after a traveler returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo developed fever and is in isolation. The patient has been transferred to Sheba Medical Center for testing; results are expected today. An epidemiological investigation will identify contacts; those not contacted need not act. No confirmed Ebola case has been reported in Israel. Ebola is not airborne and transmission requires direct contact with a symptomatic patient or with blood, bodily fluids, or contaminated materials, with highest risk during vomiting/diarrhea and in care settings. Handling the deceased requires strict precautions. Travelers from DRC who develop fever within 21 days should stay home, avoid contact, and call the Health Ministry's Hotline at 5400*. Public guidance advises avoiding nonessential travel to DRC and seeking pre-travel medical advice.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola: A person who returned from Congo was placed in isolation at Sheba.
article.articleSummary: As of 04 October 2026, Israel reports a suspected case of Ebola virus disease after a traveler returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo developed fever. The patient is in strict isolation at Sheba Medical Center (Tel Hashomer), one of the designated facilities prepared to manage high-risk infectious diseases; lab tests are underway with results expected today. Health authorities stress that this is a suspicion, not a confirmed case, and that investigations to identify contacts are ongoing. Ebola is not airborne; transmission requires direct contact with an infected, symptomatic person or with blood, body fluids, or secretions. Israel has not diagnosed a confirmed case to date. The Health Ministry is enforcing protocols, providing protective equipment, and promoting early traveler screening. People who traveled to Congo should avoid travel if possible; those developing symptoms within 21 days should stay home and call the Kol HaBriut Health Hotline at 5400.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola infection in a man after returning from Congo; he was isolated at Sheba Hospital.
article.articleSummary: A man who returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo is suspected of Ebola virus disease and is isolated at Sheba Hospital in Israel. He is receiving care in isolation while laboratory tests are conducted to determine whether he is infected, with results expected later today. Israel's Ministry of Health is monitoring Ebola outbreaks in parts of the Congo and has advised travelers returning from outbreak areas who develop fever or other symptoms to contact health authorities and not seek medical care without prior coordination. The incubation period for Ebola ranges from two to 21 days, and a person becomes contagious only after symptoms appear. The incident underscores vigilance for imported cases as authorities work to contain possible transmission while awaiting lab confirmation.

article.articleHeadline: Tekan Risiko Gigitan Rabies, Karantina Lampung dan PDHI Gelar Vaksinasi Door to Door di Desa Legundi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To Reduce the Risk of Rabies Bites, Lampung Quarantine and PDHI Hold Door-to-Door Vaccination in Legundi Village.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination drive in Lampung Selatan, Lampung Province, Indonesia, targeted nine hamlets in Legundi Village, Ketapang District. On 3 October 2026, Lampung Quarantine Office, in collaboration with PDHI Lampung and the Lampung Selatan Animal Husbandry and Health Office, conducted free door-to-door rabies vaccination, reaching 149 animals: 81 dogs and 68 cats. The campaign, timed to World Rabies Day and Indonesia's 149th Quarantine Day, emphasized comprehensive rabies control beyond urban centers. Lampung Province logged 493 animal-bite cases in 2025, underscoring ongoing transmission risk. Officials highlighted vaccination as the main defense to interrupt transmission, while sustained pet care is vital for program continuity. The outreach approach brings veterinary services directly to households, reinforcing public-health outreach in rural communities and reducing bite-risk locally.

article.articleHeadline: പേവിഷബാധ സൂക്ഷിക്കണം | Rabies is Fatal, but Preventable with Vigilance and Timely Care
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be careful about rabies infection | Rabies is fatal, but preventable with vigilance and timely care.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains deadly but preventable. Globally, rabies kills more than 59,000 people annually, with India about 5,700 deaths and Kerala reporting 22 in 2024 and 33 in 2025; roughly 95% of deaths arise from dog bites. Rabies is caused by a Lyssavirus and spreads mainly via bites from dogs, cats, foxes, and jackals; the virus is present in saliva and can be inactivated by heat and common disinfectants such as formalin, potassium permanganate, and phenol. Prevention centers on vaccination: pets (dogs and cats) should be vaccinated at 3 months, followed by a booster after 21 days and yearly thereafter; ensure all pet dogs are licensed. Do not ignore bites—wash wounds with soap and water, apply antiseptic, and seek urgent medical care. Do not abandon stray animals; implement humane control and vaccination programs. Milk from rabid cattle should be pasteurized, which renders it safe.

article.articleSummary: Fifth suspected Ebola case in Israel this year. On 2026-10-04, Israel’s Health Ministry reported a person returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo who developed fever and is under investigation for Ebola; no confirmed case yet. The patient was isolated at Sheba Medical Center (Tel Hashomer) as a suspected case, with epidemiological contact-tracing underway. Laboratory tests will be conducted per standard protocols; those not directly contacted are not required to act at this time. The ministry emphasized that Ebola is not airborne and spreads via direct contact with an ill person or with blood, body fluids, or secretions. This year four other suspected cases—also returning from DR Congo—were investigated and later ruled out. Public health measures include monitoring, PPE, and rapid testing. Citizens should avoid nonessential travel to outbreak areas; returnees with symptoms within 21 days should isolate at home and call Kol HaBriut at 5400*.

article.articleHeadline: Alta Floresta instala estações com larvicida no Cemitério Municipal para combater o Aedes aegypti " Notícia Exata - Notícias de Alta Floresta e Região!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alta Floresta installs larvicide stations in the Municipal Cemetery to combat Aedes aegypti
article.articleSummary: Alta Floresta, Mato Grosso, Brazil, launches Aedes aegypti control at the Municipal Cemetery by installing Larvicide Dissemination Stations (EDLs) in strategic locations to target water-filled containers and breeding sites. The initiative, a collaboration between the City Hall and the Mato Grosso State Health Secretariat (SES-MT), aims to reduce transmission risks of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika virus. According to Max Favaro, a SUS technician with SES-MT, the EDLs differ from household traps and are placed where water accumulations and plant vases near tombstones are common. The cemetery was chosen for its potential water-holding vessels. The effort is part of broader prevention and control measures, with staff ensuring installations do not obstruct visitors; the public is asked not to move or tamper with the devices and to contact the cemetery administration with questions. Emphasizes community participation in eliminating mosquito breeding sites.

article.articleHeadline: El ministro francés de Exteriores pedirá más recursos para luchar contra el ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The French Foreign Minister will request more resources to fight Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared May 15, continues with 8,376 cases and 4,042 deaths confirmed as of Oct 1, 2026; global case fatality rate about 48.3%. Recovery stands at 2,182, with 869 currently hospitalized or in isolation. The outbreak spans 63 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri (east), Tshopo (center-north), Bas-Uélé (north), Haut-Uélé (northeast), North Kivu (east), South Kivu (east), and Ubangi del Sur (northwest). Uganda declared the end of its outbreak on Aug 26, tallying 20 cases, including 15 imported from DRC, and 2 deaths. In Bunia, Ituri, French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot urged expanding humanitarian funding to finish the Ebola response; he met President Félix Tshisekedi in Kinshasa, commending Congolese authorities for containment and cross-border protection and pledging continued French research and aid support.

article.articleHeadline: Ayam Tampak Sehat Tak Jaminan Bebas Penyakit, Ini Saran Pakar soal Ancaman Flu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickens May Look Healthy, Not Guaranteed to Be Disease-Free: Expert Advice on the Flu Threat.
article.articleSummary: Healthy-appearing backyard chickens can harbor Avian Influenza infections. In Indonesia, including insights from Yogyakarta-based experts, molecular biology professor Chairul Anwar Nidom (UNAIR) warns that birds may be infected despite a normal exterior. Avian Influenza strains are categorized by the US CDC into Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI), which can cause high mortality in poultry, and Low Pathogenic Avian Influenza (LPAI), with mild or no signs. Owners should not rely on looks alone; routine health checks are advised to prevent spread to other poultry or humans. Watch for changes in appetite or water intake, lethargy, abnormal droppings, respiratory distress, reduced egg production, or physical changes such as a pale comb. Local content creator Rita from Yogyakarta notes such signs; autopsies may show bleeding from the nose to the lungs. As of 4 October 2026, no outbreak counts are reported in the article.

article.articleHeadline: Застрашен ли е светът от нова епидемия от чума след случая в Русия и колко опасна е болестта днес?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the world at risk of a new plague outbreak after the case in Russia, and how dangerous is the disease today?
article.articleSummary: As of 4 October 2026, authorities report a pneumonic plague case in the Irkutsk region, Russia, after a 28-year-old laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Institute for Plague Control died following exposure to Yersinia pestis. About 200 people who may have been in contact were isolated; 189 were hospitalized for observation, and the hospital in the Shelekhovsky district was quarantined. Uzbekistan has tightened sanitary controls as a precaution. Investigations are underway to determine the infection source and contact exposure. Pneumonic plague is the most dangerous form and can spread between people via respiratory droplets; without treatment, death can occur within 18–24 hours after symptoms onset. Early diagnosis and antibiotic therapy greatly improve outcomes; close contacts receive prophylactic antibiotics and isolation with PPE. The WHO says plague remains dangerous but does not presently indicate a global epidemic, with natural foci persisting in places such as the DRC and Madagascar.
