Prevention during holidays emphasizes avoiding tick exposure in grassy areas, wearing long clothing, using repellents, thorough bathing and body checks, regular pet and livestock parasite control, and seeking prompt medical care if fever persists 6–7 days after a bite, informing doctors of outdoor exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 咬まれて一口、高熱が続き、命の危機！専門家が警告：連休中の野外お花見で『見えない刺客』に要注意
triage.triage_reason: 中国で既知のエンデミック感染症であるSFTSの単発症例報告であり、休日の注意喚起を目的とした啓発記事。アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: SFTSは中国で季節性に報告される既知の疾患であり、本記事は単発の重症回復症例を基にした休日の野外活動における予防啓発記事。アウトブレイクの兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies deaths recorded in India far lesser than estimates from ICMR-led study
article.articleSummary: Rabies deaths in India show a large surveillance–estimation gap. IDSP-IHIP data for 2022–2024 record 21, 50, and 54 rabies deaths, with 2025 only noting a January death; full-year figures are unavailable. The MCCD system counted 66 rabies deaths in 2022 and 271 in 2023, but covers only medically certified deaths. In contrast, an ICMR-NIE Lancet Infectious Diseases study estimated about 5,726 rabies deaths annually in India, based on a survey of 3,37,808 people across 60 districts in 15 states, plus lab data and a probability-tree model; India experiences roughly 9.1 million animal bites yearly, including 5.6 million dog bites. The study underscores dog vaccination, prompt post-exposure prophylaxis, and a One Health approach to eliminate dog-mediated human rabies by 2030. WHO notes dogs account for up to 99% of transmission; India accounts for about 35% of global deaths and ~60% in Asia.

triage.headline_ja: インドにおける狂犬病死亡数、ICMR主導研究の推定値よりはるかに少なく記録
triage.triage_reason: 新規アウトブレイクではなく、インドにおける狂犬病死亡数のサーベイランスと推定のギャップに関する既存研究の報告記事であり、異常事態や緊急対応を要する事象ではない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドの風土病であり、本記事はサーベイランスデータと研究推定値の乖離を指摘する学術的報告。緊急の公衆衛生対応を要する新規イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: State intensifies malaria surveillance after 37,899 cases, 9 deaths
article.articleSummary: Odisha, India, records 37,899 malaria cases and nine deaths as of August 2026, prompting intensified surveillance and containment. The health department has directed malaria-prone districts to escalate active case detection, rapid testing with rapid diagnostic kits, and immediate treatment, focusing on high-burden pockets. Sub-centre–level surveillance has been strengthened; fever and malaria-like symptoms are screened routinely, and confirmed cases receive prompt treatment to prevent complications. Anti-malaria activities—drug distribution, vector-control measures, and monitoring of trends—are scaled up, with hotspot tracking and ensuring adequate testing kits and medicines. Public awareness campaigns emphasize long-lasting insecticidal nets, mosquito-bite prevention, and early medical consultation, especially in tribal and forested areas. Even with a high caseload, deaths remain low due to timely diagnosis and treatment. Odisha accounts for about 26.6% of India’s roughly 142,000 nationwide malaria cases in that period; the 2024 burden (68,693) was higher, and intensified surveillance will continue in endemic pockets.

triage.headline_ja: 37,899件の症例、9人の死亡を受けオディシャ州がマラリア監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: インド・オディシャ州での既知の風土病マラリアの季節的サーベイランス強化報告であり、致死率は低く国内で対応可能だが、流行地域での症例動向は継続的に注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: マラリアはインド・オディシャ州の風土病であり、本記事は年次/季節的な保健当局の対応強化を報告する内容。致死率は低く(9/37,899)、既存の国内対策枠組み内で管理されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Antraks Ditemukan di Gunungkidul, Kementan Perkuat Pengendalian
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anthrax cases found in Gunungkidul, Ministry of Agriculture strengthens control.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax (Bacillus anthracis) detected in Dadapayu, Kalurahan Dadapayu, Kapanewon Semanu, Gunungkidul Regency, DIY. The Ministry of Agriculture strengthens control with integrated actions: epidemiological investigation, livestock health services, disinfection, vaccination, laboratory testing, animal health surveillance, and community education. Investigations began 11 September 2026; disinfection on 12 September; antibiotics and vitamins given to 88 goats and 11 cattle on 14 September. Vaccination of nearby livestock started 28 September to boost protection. Laboratory confirmation came from BBV Wates, with positive Bacillus anthracis results guiding response. Public is urged not to slaughter, process, or consume sick or suddenly dead livestock and to report promptly. Ongoing surveillance and environmental sampling (soil, swabs) continue, with coordination between animal and human health sectors and market oversight.

triage.headline_ja: グヌンキドゥルで炭疽菌が検出され、農業省が対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・グヌンキドゥル県（炭疽の既知流行地域）で家畜（ヤギ・牛）の炭疽感染が確認されたが、ヒトへの感染は報告されておらず、政府による通常の防疫対応（消毒・ワクチン接種・監視）が進行中であるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: グヌンキドゥルは炭疽の常在地域として知られ、家畜間での散発的発生は例年報告されている。ヒトへの感染や国際的拡大の兆候は記事中に記載なし。土壌中の炭疽菌芽胞による環境曝露の継続リスクはあるが、既に家畜への抗生物質投与・ワクチン接種・消毒等の対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Antraks Kembali Ditemukan, Penanganan Terpadu Langsung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anthrax Case Reappears, Immediate Integrated Response
article.articleSummary: Anthrax case detected in Dadapayu, Kelurahan Dadapayu, Kapanewon Semanu, Gunungkidul, DI Yogyakarta, prompting an integrated veterinary response. The Ministry of Agriculture (Ditjen PKH) supports Gunungkidul through joint actions with regional government and field animal health officers. Coordinated measures include epidemiological investigation, livestock healthcare, disinfection, vaccination, laboratory testing, animal health surveillance, and community communication and education. Operations are conducted with personnel wearing full PPE and on-site sterilization to prevent wider transmission. The district initiated an epidemiological inquiry on 11 September 2026 to trace the event and assess nearby livestock, collecting samples for testing. On 12 September, disinfection of affected pens, treatment of sick animals, and vitamin administration to surrounding healthy stock occurred. On 14 September, antibiotics and vitamins were given to 88 goats and 11 cows in Dadapayu. Surveillance remains ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 炭疽菌症例が再発見、統合対応を即時実施
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・グヌンキドゥルで家畜（ヤギ・牛）の炭疽菌発生が確認され、獣医当局による対応が進行中だが、ヒト感染や重症例の記載はなく、国際的拡大の兆候も不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物（ヤギ・牛）における炭疽菌発生に関するものであり、ヒトへの感染や症例についての記載はない。地方政府と農業省による統合的対応（疫学調査、消毒、ワクチン接種、治療）が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'daki Ebola salgınında can kaybı 4 bini aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in Congo has surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Bundibugyo-type Ebola outbreak, which began in May 2026, has become the country’s largest and deadliest on record, with Reuters reporting on Oct 2, 2026: 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths. Suspected cases emerged April 24; a high-mortality cluster in Ituri province’s Mongbwalu area prompted alerts by May 5, with lab confirmation of Bundibugyo on May 15. By Sept 25, the WHO said the outbreak reached seven of 26 provinces and 63 health zones, with 7,890 cases and 3,799 deaths; a Sept 30 WHO Africa Region update listed 7,773 cases and 3,759 deaths, reflecting reporting differences. No licensed vaccine or virus-specific therapy exists for Bundibugyo Ebola; control relies on early detection, isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, and supportive care. The outbreak has surpassed Congo’s 2018–2020 record (3,470 cases, 2,287 deaths) and ranks second to the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (28,600+ cases, >11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が史上最大規模に拡大し、死者4,000人超・7州63保健地区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ワクチン・特異的治療薬がないブンディブギョ型エボラであり、2018-2020年の記録を超え史上最大の流行となっている。Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及なしのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases cross 20,000 in TN; Chennai steps up monsoon vigil
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Tamil Nadu have crossed 20,000 this year, with Chennai registering 4,592 cases and no deaths to date. Chennai logged 1,293 cases in September from 16,254 tests; 3,703 mosquito-control workers are deployed and 1,250 larvicidal-spraying machines are in operation, with over 100 medical camps daily. A recent update recorded 46 cases on a Saturday, while Rs 7.2 lakh in fines were issued for improper waste disposal. Ahead of the northeast monsoon, stormwater drains are being desilted: over 3,000 km in Chennai and 250 km under the Highways Department, with 1,400 of 1,600 blocked km desilted and 200 km remaining to reach 99% completion. State and city funding includes Rs 1,100 crore to clear pending payments, a Rs 300 crore loan, and Rs 100 crore for monsoon works; 215 relief centres and 111 community kitchens are ready, with drone-based biological interventions underway.

triage.headline_ja: タミルナドゥ州でデング熱患者数が2万人を突破、チェンナイはモンスーンに向け警戒強化
triage.triage_reason: インド・タミルナドゥ州における季節性のデング熱流行であり、死亡者なし・地元当局による対策（人員・資金・設備）が十分に講じられている。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低く、通常の年次流行報道の範囲内と判断。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド・タミルナドゥ州（チェンナイ含む）で毎年モンスーン期に発生する風土病的流行。死亡者ゼロで、州・市当局が十分な資金・人員・資材を投入し対応中。国際的な懸念材料はなく、継続監視不要と判断。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Andhra Pradesh: Bird Flu Outbreak Triggers Alert
article.articleSummary: Bird flu, caused by H5N1 avian influenza, triggers an alert in Andhra Pradesh. In Siddapuram village, Bukkarayasamudram mandal, Anantapur district, about 2600 country chickens died a couple of days ago, with more than 4000 local birds dying in the past few days. Veterinary experts from Vijayawada collected samples and laboratory confirmation established bird flu as the cause. A second outbreak hit a poultry farm in Pamidi mandal on Saturday, causing substantial losses. District authorities have escalated surveillance, launched awareness programs, and urged residents to keep poultry away from homes and report unusual bird deaths. Earlier outbreaks in Anantapur, Satya Sai, Annamayya, and Chittoor districts with H5N1 led to containment and villages being declared free after control. Officials will continue monitoring Siddapuram and surrounding areas; no details on infection source or imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラ・プラデーシュ州：鳥インフルエンザ発生が警戒を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: H5N1による家禽の大量死が確認されているが、ヒト感染例の報告はなく、地域当局が監視・封じ込め対応を実施中であるため、継続的な経過観察が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（動物）における鳥インフルエンザ（H5N1）の発生であり、ヒトへの感染報告はない。過去にも同地域で発生・封じ込めの事例があり、再発パターンと見られる。ヒトへのスピルオーバーの可能性について継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : Paris entend renforcer son aide, à quelques jours de la conférence nationale humanitaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: Paris intends to strengthen its aid, a few days before the national humanitarian conference.
article.articleSummary: From Bunia in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot announced that Paris will strengthen its support for the Ebola response ahead of a national humanitarian conference in Paris. He indicated, during forthcoming budget talks, that France would propose a humanitarian funding package to 'go all the way' in the fight, though no amount was disclosed. He described the Ebola outbreak, ongoing since May, as the deadliest in the DRC’s history and the second-worst globally. He credited Congolese authorities, UN agencies, NGOs, and French partners for preventing spillover to other regions, major cities, Europe, and French overseas territories, while warning that the epidemic could resurge quickly. Barrot praised researchers, frontline healthcare workers, and French associations, including the PRISM program. He framed aid as under political attack and argued that about 30 cents per French citizen is essential to protect both Congolese and French populations.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ：パリは国家人道会議を前に支援強化を表明
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行は同国史上最悪・世界で2番目に深刻とされ、フランス政府が緊急資金拠出を検討するなど国際的関心・支援ニーズが高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はフランス外相のブニア訪問と資金援助表明が主題だが、エボラ流行自体はDRC国内で発生・進行中の事案である。フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : Paris veut renforcer son aide avant la conférence humanitaire - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Paris wants to bolster its aid ahead of the humanitarian conference - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) near Bunia prompts France to bolster aid ahead of a humanitarian conference in Paris. On October 3, 2026, French Minister of Europe and Foreign Affairs Jean-Noël Barrot announced plans to propose additional humanitarian funding during upcoming budget discussions to support the Ebola response, including vaccine research and equipment for organizations involved in the outbreak response. France aims to strengthen its support for the DRC’s Ebola efforts while maintaining vigilance against possible resurgence. A national humanitarian conference is scheduled in Paris on October 6, 2026, gathering NGOs, donors, and international bodies to discuss humanitarian action principles, resources, and financing. This aid intention follows a MaliActu situation update dated October 2, 2026, noting ongoing monitoring of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱（DRC）：パリは人道会議を前に支援強化を目指す - Mali Actu
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対し、フランスが人道会議を開催し資金・ワクチン支援を強化する動きがあり、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はフランスの支援方針に焦点を当てているが、根本的なイベントはDRC（Bunia付近）で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク。フランス・パリは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Memperketat Pengawasan untuk Antisipasi Influenza A di Sulsel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tighten Surveillance to Anticipate Influenza A in South Sulawesi
article.articleSummary: Influenza A surveillance is being tightened in South Sulawesi, Indonesia, with Makassar-based health authorities boosting monitoring of influenza-like illness (ILI) and severe acute respiratory infections to prevent local transmission. As of early October 2026, the Sulawesi Selatan provincial health office (Dinkes Sulsel) has not detected any influenza A cases in the province, though national influenza activity rose in August–September 2026 and followed seasonal patterns. The ministry and provincial authorities are enhancing early warning and facility readiness from primary clinics (puskesmas) to hospitals for detection, testing, monitoring, and clinical management according to illness severity. Oseltamivir antivirals have been distributed to facilities but are not for mass consumption; use is medically indicated. Mild cases require rest and supportive care; severe or high-risk patients need further medical evaluation. Do not attribute rises to heat or El Niño; maintain hygiene and strong immune health.

triage.headline_ja: 南スラウェシでインフルエンザAに備え監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 南スラウェシ州では実際のインフルエンザA症例は確認されておらず、季節性インフルエンザ活動への予防的な監視強化に関する内容であり、異常性・重大性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザに対する予防的な監視体制強化を報じたものであり、実際の症例確認や異常な流行は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kementan Perkuat Pengendalian Penyakit Hewan Usai Ditemukan Kasus Antraks di Gunungkidul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Agriculture Strengthens Control of Animal Diseases After Anthrax Case Found in Gunungkidul.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax case detected in Gunungkidul Regency, Yogyakarta Special Region, prompting integrated control by the Ministry of Agriculture's Directorate General of Animal Husbandry and Animal Health (Ditjen PKH) in collaboration with regional government and frontline animal health workers. Response includes epidemiological investigation, livestock health services, disinfection, vaccination, and laboratory testing, with ongoing surveillance. The Gunungkidul Agriculture and Food Service conducted an epidemiological investigation on 11 September 2026 to trace the event, assess nearby livestock, and collect samples. On 12 September, disinfection of the affected pen, treatment of animals needing care, and vitamins for healthy animals nearby. On 14 September, antibiotic and vitamin administration to 88 goats and 11 cattle in Dadapayu Village. After the antibiotic course, anthrax vaccination began on 28 September 2026 for surrounding livestock to enhance protection and reduce future risk.

triage.headline_ja: グヌンキドゥルで炭疽菌症例確認後、農業省が動物疾病対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・グヌンキドゥルでの家畜（ヤギ・牛）の炭疽菌感染事例であり、人への感染や重大な公衆衛生上の影響は報告されていない。地元当局による通常の疫学調査・消毒・ワクチン接種対応が行われており、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 本事例は動物（ヤギ・牛）における炭疽菌感染であり、人への感染は記事中に言及されていない。インドネシアでは炭疽菌は地域的に既知の人獣共通感染症であり、今回の対応も通常の家畜衛生管理の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Un laboratorio móvil en el Congo reduce de 72 a seis horas el diagnóstico del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A mobile laboratory in the Congo reduces the time to diagnose Ebola from 72 hours to six hours.
article.articleSummary: Mobile diagnostic unit in Butembo, Democratic Republic of the Congo, accelerates Ebola diagnosis from up to 72 hours to under 24, sometimes six. The mobile lab, mounted on a negative‑pressure truck, processes blood samples on site with INRB technicians; no fixed-center referrals needed. Its mobility brings testing to hard‑to‑reach populations, including Katwa, enabling rapid treatment decisions. The outbreak, declared May 15, has reached 8,300 confirmed cases across seven cities and 4,018 deaths. North Kivu province accounts for about 40% of new infections since late August, per MSF. The faster results allow earlier antiviral therapy and quicker disposition of negatives back to standard health services; over 2,000 patients have recovered. Weekly cases fell from about 850 in July to about 490 in September, with deaths from 470 to 230. Africa CDC warns declines may reflect insecurity and community cooperation barriers; number of mobile units not specified.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの移動検査室がエボラ診断時間を72時間から6時間に短縮
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ流行（確定症例8,300例、死亡4,018例）に関する重要アップデートであり、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は移動検査室という技術的進展に焦点を当てているが、背景として継続中の大規模エボラ流行（北キブ州中心、7都市、4,018死亡）の最新状況を示しており、既存アウトブレイクの重要アップデートとしてPICKUP判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : la France veut renforcer son aide
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: France wants to bolster its aid.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), specifically Bunia: On 3 October 2026, French Minister of Europe and Foreign Affairs Jean-Noël Barrot announced plans to propose additional humanitarian funding for Ebola response, to be raised during upcoming budget discussions. He urged continued vigilance against the risk of Ebola resurgence. The announcement precedes a national humanitarian conference in Paris on 6 October 2026, expected to gather NGOs, donors and international organizations to discuss humanitarian action principles, resources, and financing. The French Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in a briefing published 1 October 2026, stated that the aid would notably support vaccine research and the equipping of organizations engaged in the health response. The article highlights France’s intended increase in Ebola preparedness assistance for the DRC, with no current case counts reported in the piece.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱：フランスは支援強化を目指す
triage.triage_reason: エボラ再燃リスクへの警戒喚起とフランスの支援拡大方針が報じられているが、現時点での症例数等の具体的情報がなく、DRC国内の流行状況は不明なため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はフランスの人道支援拡大方針に関する報道であり、DRC国内の具体的な症例数や発生状況の記載がないため、エボラの実際の流行規模は不明。フランス（パリ）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Sumut Klaim Ada Kasus Peningkatan Influenza A, Temukan 27 Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Sumatra Health Office Claims Increased Influenza A Cases; 27 Cases Found
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases rise in North Sumatra, with 27 reported from January–September 2026, according to North Sumatra Health Office Secretary Hamid Rijal Lubis. The increase, noted last month, follows a higher incidence than 2025 but remains under control. Sentinel testing is conducted at two facilities designated by the Ministry of Health: Puskesmas Teladan Medan and RSUD Amri Tambunan in Deliserdang Regency; others may detect cases but reporting to these two centers is the basis for the 27 figure. Influenza A is a contagious viral respiratory infection presenting with high fever, muscle pains, fatigue, dry cough, and headache. Transmission occurs rapidly via droplets. Authorities urge rest, hydration, nutritious meals, and prompt hospital evaluation. If Influenza A is suspected, hospitals will refer patients to the designated sentinel centers. No further details on outbreaks or fatalities are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 北スマトラ州保健局、インフルエンザA型症例増加を発表、27例確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの軽微な増加報告であり、重症度・異常性・国際的拡大の懸念を示す情報がなく、当局も「管理下にある」としている。
triage.notes: 27例は2026年1-9月の累積数で、2025年より増加傾向だが「管理下」と報告されており、死亡例や重症例の言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à la Tshopo : décès d'un infirmier titulaire à Kisangani - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: death of a permanent nurse in Kisangani - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) fatality reported in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. On 4 October 2026, a permanent nurse from the Tout va bien health center on 6th Avenue in Kisangani’s Tshopo commune died at the General Reference Hospital of Tshopo at 01:30 after being refused admission to the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE). He had been active in Ebola response activities. A source said he may have been hospitalized at Millennium Hospital before a late transfer. This death brings to two frontline health workers who have died of Ebola in Kisangani within a week, underscoring ongoing transmission and risk among responders in the city.

triage.headline_ja: ツショピ州でのエボラ出血熱：キサンガニで常勤看護師が死亡 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によるコンゴ民主共和国（キサンガニ）での医療従事者の死亡が報告され、1週間で2人目の最前線医療従事者が死亡しており、持続的な感染伝播とヒト-ヒト感染リスクが懸念されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ治療センター（CTE）への入院を拒否された後に死亡したという情報は、医療提供体制の逼迫や対応能力の限界を示唆しており、注視が必要。1週間で2人目の医療従事者の死亡は院内感染・対応中の感染拡大リスクを示す重要な兆候。

article.articleHeadline: הוסר החשד לאבולה: תוצאות שליליות לחולה ששב מקונגו
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspicion of Ebola ruled out: negative results for the patient who returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 4 October 2026, Israel's Ministry of Health reported negative Ebola test results for a patient hospitalized in isolation after returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and developing symptoms. No confirmed Ebola case has been identified in Israel. Ebola is not transmitted via air; infection occurs only through direct contact with a symptomatic patient or with blood, body fluids, or secretions. Tests were conducted per professional protocols and internationally accepted guidelines for handling highly contagious diseases. The ministry will continue to monitor the situation and keep healthcare workers and the public updated. The incident represents an imported suspected case that was ruled out by laboratory testing, underscoring ongoing vigilance to prevent importation and spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑いを除外：コンゴから帰国した患者の検査結果は陰性
triage.triage_reason: イスラエルでの疑い患者はエボラ検査で陰性と判明し、感染は確認されていない。対象国での発生事実もなく、公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 疑い患者はイスラエルで発生し検査は陰性。コンゴ(DRC)は渡航歴として言及されているのみで、同国内でのエボラ発生事実は記事に記載されていないため対象国に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Flood-hit Faizullaganj: Crawling threats add to woes
article.articleSummary: As of 04 October 2026, floodwaters continue to surround Faizullaganj homes, with snakes and other dangerous creatures entering residential areas; a crocodile video near a house is unverified. Dense water hyacinths clog inundated pockets, raising safety concerns for children and the elderly. Residents like Sonam Maurya and Nidhi Mishra report sleepless nights guarding children as snakebite fears grow. Bal Mahila Sangthan, a relief group, assists families and helps them reach relief camps and obtain medicines. Civil Hospital consultant Dr Kuldeep Verma warns floodwater can carry dirt, microorganisms and insecticides, increasing the risk of waterborne diseases such as hepatitis A, cholera and typhoid.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水被害のファイズラガンジ：忍び寄る脅威が住民の苦難に追い打ち
triage.triage_reason: 現時点では具体的な感染症症例の報告はなく、医師による水系感染症（A型肝炎・コレラ・腸チフス）発生リスクへの警告に留まるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は洪水による環境リスク（蛇・ワニ等）と水系感染症発生の可能性についての警告報道であり、実際の感染症症例発生の確認情報はない。洪水が継続している状況のため、今後の感染症発生動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Russia denies plague death at Irkutsk institute as aluminium plant orders masks
article.articleSummary: Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor denied that an Irkutsk anti-plague institute employee died of plague, saying Darya Shpilova hospitalised Sept 29 and died Oct 1 from pneumonia of undetermined origin. No plague cases confirmed; a commission found no accidents at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute and no staff showing symptoms. Investigators explored Thailand travel and a laboratory accident with a broken test tube as infection sources, but found no evidence. The region’s epidemiological situation remains stable. About 197 people in contact with the deceased were identified; 189 hospitalised for observation (114 regional, 63 other, 12 institute), eight not hospitalised; all tests negative. Shelekhov district ward closed Oct 1. Emergency meeting and action plan were launched; residents were urged to limit visits to Shelekhov and towns; a cleanup in Irkutsk was postponed. Irkutsk Aluminium Plant imposed masks. An epidemiologist said the infection is likely not plague; Uzbekistan tightened border controls with no confirmed plague cases.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、イルクーツク研究所でのペスト死亡を否定、アルミ工場はマスク着用を指示
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究施設関係者の死亡を巡り、ロシア当局は否定したものの197人の接触者調査・189人入院観察・地域封鎖・隣国の国境強化など大規模な公衆衛生対応が取られており、IHR基準の複数該当とフルリスク評価の必要性が認められる。
triage.notes: 本イベントはロシア（イルクーツク州）で発生しており、対象国リストに該当なし。タイは渡航歴調査の対象として言及されているのみで発生地域ではない。ウズベキスタンは予防的に国境管理を強化したが確定症例はなく、対象国リストにも含まれない。ペストとの確定診断はされておらず、死因は原因不明の肺炎とされている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: KOLIKO JE OPASNA KUGA? SMRTONOSNA EPIDEMIJA PRETI RUSIJI Darja je umrla za samo tri dana: Ova bakterija ubija i za 24 sata, a evo da li može da se izleči
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How Dangerous Is the Plague? A Deadly Epidemic Threatens Russia. Darja Died in Just Three Days: This Bacterium Kills in as Little as 24 Hours, and Whether It Can Be Cured.
article.articleSummary: Death of Darja Silipova, a 28-year-old lab worker at the Irkutsk Institute for Plague Control, after a September 25 accident releasing Yersinia pestis; she died October 2. In Irkutsk Oblast, about 200 people are under medical monitoring after exposure; the hospital unit in Shelekhov was quarantined, and several departments halted admissions and discharges. At least 197 potential contacts have been under surveillance or isolated. Plague persists in natural reservoirs; transmission via flea bites, direct contact with infectious tissue, or inhalation of respiratory droplets in pneumonic plague. Pneumonic form is highly contagious and can progress rapidly; symptoms include severe respiratory distress and coughing; in untreated pneumonic/septicemic forms, mortality is high; antibiotics are effective if started early, ideally within 24 hours. WHO emphasizes rapid isolation and antibiotic prophylaxis for contacts. Global background: 2019-2025 highest reported cases in DRC and Madagascar.

triage.headline_ja: ペストはどれほど危険か？致命的な流行がロシアを脅かす―ダリヤはわずか3日で死亡。この細菌は24時間で命を奪うこともあり、治療可能かどうかを解説
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究施設事故によりYersinia pestis感染で死亡例が発生し、約200人が接触者として監視・隔離下にある。肺ペストという重症度の高い病原体であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常事態）に2つ該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例はロシア・イルクーツク州の研究所における実験室内感染事故であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。記事中のDRC・Madagascarへの言及は2019-2025年の世界的背景データとして挙げられているのみで、本イベントの発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC Supports DR Congo in Strengthening Transparency and Accountability in Ebola Response Funding
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola response funding guidance: Africa CDC backs Kinshasa’s push to strengthen transparency, traceability and accountability for resources mobilised to fight Ebola. In Kinshasa, the Ministry of Public Health, Hygiene and Social Welfare aligns with a 5 August 2026 high-level meeting chaired by President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo, urging stronger coordination and financial accountability. Africa CDC will lead resource mobilisation, facilitate timely disbursement to countries and partners, and provide high-level technical assistance. Donor commitments have reached US$2.9 billion, following Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka’s G20+ appeal at the 23 September 2026 UN General Assembly side event in New York for rapid disbursement and effective use. Every dollar must be traceable from pledge to services to communities. Partners should align with national priorities and provide complete financial information; Africa CDC will enhance its Financial Tracking Mechanism, identify gaps and reduce duplication, to end the outbreak and protect communities.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、エボラ対応資金における透明性と説明責任の強化でコンゴ民主共和国を支援
triage.triage_reason: 既存のDRCエボラ流行に対する資金管理・ガバナンスに関する記事であり、新規の感染拡大や臨床的異常を示す内容ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ対応資金の透明性・説明責任強化に関する内容で、新規感染状況や臨床情報は含まれない。New YorkやUnited Statesは国連総会サイドイベントの開催地として言及されているのみで発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, il farmaco si prova prima dei sintomi: i 21 giorni di attesa potrebbero diventare tempo di cura
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the drug is tested before symptoms appear: the 21-day waiting period could become a time for treatment.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is prompting a new approach: the EBO-PEP trial tests obeldesivir as post-exposure prophylaxis for asymptomatic, high-risk contacts within five days of exposure to a confirmed case. More than 250 participants have been enrolled since July, with a target near 1,000; eligible individuals are adults or youths over 12 and are monitored through the 21-day incubation. The outbreak is massive, with AP counting over 8,300 confirmed cases and more than 4,000 deaths, while the latest WHO bulletin (Sept 23) cites about 7,890 cases and 3,799 deaths (roughly 48% case fatality). No human efficacy data yet; preclinical evidence exists. If successful, prophylaxis could transform the response from passive surveillance to intervening during the exposure window, particularly for healthcare workers. Italy’s SSN may eventually reflect preparedness to classify exposures and offer rapid prophylaxis if validated.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、症状発現前に治療薬を試験：21日間の待機期間が治療期間になる可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は症例数8,300以上、致死率約48%と深刻であり、曝露後予防薬の国際治験が進行中であることから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリアの医療体制への示唆を含むが、感染症イベント自体はDRCで発生しているため、verified_locationsからはイタリアを除外した。

article.articleHeadline: OMS: Boli care refuză să dispară. Meningita, holera și ciuma continuă să ucidă în 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Diseases that refuse to disappear. Meningitis, cholera and plague continue to kill in 2026.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports meningitis remains in the African belt from Senegal to Ethiopia. In 2025, 24 of 26 countries reported more than 20,000 suspected cases and about 1,000 deaths, with a 2024–2025 decline of around 5.9% where data exist. Meningococcal A vaccination since 2010 reduced A-type disease by over 99%, and no confirmed A-type cases have occurred in vaccinated countries since 2017; a pentavalent vaccine is being rolled out, with Niger leading a 2025 campaign. Romania reported 10 confirmed meningitis cases in 2026; 2025 had 35 cases with one death. Cholera caused over 450,000 cases and nearly 8,000 deaths in 2025 across 47 countries, with deaths up 30% from 2024; Africa affected. Seven countries—Angola, Bangladesh, DRC, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan, Yemen—accounted for about 90% of cases and deaths. Plague persists: 2019–2025 saw roughly 4,000 suspected cases and over 400 deaths (CFR ~11%), mainly in DRC and Madagascar; rodent/flea surveillance and rapid response remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：消えることを拒む疾患。髄膜炎、コレラ、ペストが2026年も死者を出し続けている
triage.triage_reason: WHOの年次総括記事であり新規の突発的事象ではないが、DRCがコレラ・ペストの主要被害国として継続的に言及されており、死亡率上昇など注視すべき情報が含まれるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHOによる2025年の複数疾患（髄膜炎・コレラ・ペスト）に関する年次総括レポートであり、新規の突発的イベントではない。対象国の中ではDRCがコレラ（主要7か国の一つ）およびペスト（主要流行地）の双方で継続的に言及されている。ナイジェリア、マダガスカル、スーダン、イエメン、アンゴラ、ルーマニア、バングラデシュ、ニジェール、セネガル、エチオピアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Red Cross Driver Dies After Ebola Response Mission in DRC
article.articleSummary: As of 4 October 2026, Ismael Mulindwa, a Uganda Red Cross Society driver, died after almost a month of treatment following deployment to the Democratic Republic of Congo to support the Ebola response. Mulindwa died after the Red Cross team was attacked during the mission. His death follows Uganda's Ebola-free declaration by the World Health Organization slightly more than a month earlier. He was buried in Kabimbiri, off Kayunga Road, Uganda. Mulindwa had served in URCS ambulance services and was remembered by colleagues for dedication and community impact. Colleagues described him as a dedicated worker who touched lives and built lasting relationships in the communities he served.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ赤十字の運転手、DRCでのエボラ対応任務後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ対応活動に関連した死亡事例であり、進行中のエボラアウトブレイク対応状況を示唆するため、社会的関心（報道）とWPRO重症度基準の両方に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は赤十字スタッフが攻撃を受けて死亡した点であり、エボラそのものの感染拡大に関する新規疫学情報は乏しい。DRCでの対応活動が継続している背景情報として、エボラアウトブレイクの現状を追加確認する必要がある。ウガンダはWHOによりエボラ終息宣言済みのため対象国リストから除外。ザンビアは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文中で言及なく、関連性不明のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: World Meningitis Day 2026: Bhopal Neurologists See 7-8 Patients Daily As Cases Rise In MP
article.articleSummary: On 4 October 2026, doctors in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh report rising meningitis activity, with seven to eight patients per day visiting neurologists. Madhya Pradesh is among states with a high burden of meningitis. World Meningitis Day is observed on 5 October. Meningitis, swelling of membranes around brain and spinal cord, is categorized into bacterial, viral, and tuberculous forms. Vulnerable groups include children under five and people in crowded environments such as schools or hostels; doctors note spikes in September–October–November. Warning signs include a stiff neck, sudden high fever, and severe headache. In children, bacterial and viral meningitis are more common; in adults, tuberculosis meningitis is common. The article notes no laboratory confirmation data or infection sources, and mentions no imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 世界髄膜炎デー2026：ボパールの神経内科医、マディヤ・プラデーシュ州で症例増加により1日7〜8人の患者を診察
triage.triage_reason: 世界髄膜炎デーに関連した啓発記事であり、実験室確認データや具体的な感染源情報がなく、季節的な傾向を説明する内容に留まるため、緊急のシグナルとは判断できない。
triage.notes: 記事は世界髄膜炎デーに合わせた啓発的な内容で、季節性の患者数増加を伝えるのみ。検査確認データやアウトブレイクの証拠がなく、トリアージ基準のいずれにも強く該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia steps up anthrax control after case found in Yogyakarta
article.articleSummary: Anthrax case detected in Dadapayu Village, Gunungkidul, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, prompting an intensified, integrated response by the Agriculture Ministry. Investigations, livestock health services, disinfection, vaccination, laboratory exams, and public education are under way, with ongoing surveillance. On Sept. 11, 2026, an epidemiological survey traced the incident and assessed nearby livestock; by Sept. 12, affected shelters were disinfected and animals treated; on Sept. 14, antibiotics and vitamins were given to 88 goats and 11 cattle in Dadapayu. Vaccination of surrounding livestock began Sept. 28. Officials urge residents not to slaughter, process, or consume sick or suddenly dead animals, and to report promptly to enable early action. Movement of livestock should await guidance from animal health officers as monitoring continues.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア、ジョグジャカルタで炭疽症例確認後に対策強化
triage.triage_reason: 動物の炭疽事例であり、現時点でヒトへの感染拡大や重大な公衆衛生影響は報告されていないが、家畜間の感染拡大や人への波及の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 動物（家畜）における炭疽事例であり、人への感染報告は記事中にない。政府が迅速に対応しており管理可能とみられるが、炭疽菌の環境残存性から継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Red Cross Driver Dies After Ebola Response Mission in DRC
article.articleSummary: On 4 October 2026, a Uganda Red Cross Society (URCS) driver, Ismael Mulindwa, died in Uganda after almost a month of treatment following deployment to the Democratic Republic of Congo to support the Ebola response. Mulindwa’s death comes after the Red Cross team was attacked during the operation. He was buried in Kabimbiri, off Kayunga Road. URCS Secretary General Naphtal Baguma and spokesperson Irene Nakasiita described him as a dedicated ambulance worker who built lasting relationships in the communities he served and who leaves behind a family. Mulindwa’s passing follows Uganda being declared Ebola-free by the World Health Organization slightly more than a month earlier, highlighting the continuing risks faced by responders in Ebola-related work in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ赤十字のドライバー、DRCでのエボラ対応任務後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの既知のエボラ対応活動中に攻撃を受けた人道支援者の死亡事例であり、新規の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の新しいシグナルではないが、進行中のエボラ対応状況として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は死因（エボラ感染か攻撃による外傷か）を明確にしていない。DRCでのエボラ対応は既知の進行中アウトブレイクであり、この記事自体は新規症例情報ではなく人道支援者の安全リスクに関する続報。ウガンダはすでにエボラフリー宣言済みのため対象国リストのUgandaは含まれない（リストにUganda自体が存在しない）。

article.articleHeadline: Kementan Perketat Pengendalian Antraks di Gunungkidul Usai Temuan Kasus |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Agriculture Tightens Anthrax Control in Gunungkidul Regency After Case Discovery | Republika Online
article.articleSummary: An anthrax case was detected in Dadapayu village, Gunungkidul Regency, Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta, prompting tightened control by the Ministry of Agriculture. The integrated response, led by the Directorate General of Animal Husbandry and Animal Health, includes an epidemiological investigation that began on September 11, disinfection of affected animal shelters on September 12, and treatment with antibiotics and vitamins for 88 goats and 11 cows on September 14. Vaccination of surrounding livestock commenced on September 28. Ongoing surveillance and public communication are emphasized, with a clear advisory not to slaughter, process, distribute, or consume sick or suddenly dead animals and to report promptly. Authorities stress transparency and adherence to veterinary guidance, including consulting before moving livestock from monitored areas. Laboratory testing supports the investigation alongside vaccination and health service measures, as of October 4, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 農業省、炭疽菌症例発見後グヌンキドゥル県での炭疽対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 動物（ヤギ・牛）における炭疽発生で、人への感染は報告されていないが人畜共通感染症としての監視継続が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例はインドネシア・グヌンキドゥル県における家畜（ヤギ・牛）の炭疽発生で、政府が疫学調査・消毒・抗生物質投与・ワクチン接種を実施中。人への感染例は記載されておらず、人畜共通感染症としての潜在的リスクはあるが現時点で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Krievijā satraukums par iespējamu mēra gadījumu: karantīna slimnīcās, simtiem kontaktpersonu novērošanā
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia on edge over a possible plague case: quarantine in hospitals, hundreds of contacts under surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Possible plague case in Russia's Irkutsk region triggers hospital quarantines and surveillance of hundreds. A 28-year-old laboratory worker, Darja Shipilova, at the Irkutsk Siberia and Far East Anti-Plague Institute, died after hospitalization in late September. Two contradictory narratives circulated: one claiming exposure after returning from Thailand; the official diagnosis cited is unknown etiology pneumonia, with expanded testing finding no pathogens linked to her work. Authorities imposed quarantine in several Irkutsk hospitals for up to three weeks; hundreds of people placed under observation. About 197 contacts were identified; 189 were admitted for monitoring, with some transported to the anti-plague institute; no symptoms reported among contacts per Rospotrebnadzor. The situation led to an emergency regional sanitary-epidemiological commission; Anna Popova and Governor Kobzev visited. Social-media rumors about plague prompted cautious messaging; a mask regime was introduced at a Shelekhov aluminum plant, and a city cleanup was canceled.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト疑い例に緊張高まる：病院の隔離、数百人の接触者を観察下に
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州の抗ペスト研究所職員が原因不明肺炎で死亡し、ペスト疑いで病院隔離・数百人規模の接触者監視が行われており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性の両基準に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: タイへの渡航歴による曝露説はSNS上の噂であり、公式診断では否定されている。実際の発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Assemblée de l'UIP à Arusha : paix dans l'Est congolais et Ebola au menu - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IPU Assembly in Arusha: Peace in the eastern Congo and Ebola on the agenda - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Two new items were added to the agenda of the 153rd Inter-Parliamentary Union (UIP) Assembly in Arusha, Tanzania: the security situation in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and the Ebola outbreak, with calls for stronger engagement and SADC solidarity against Ebola. The RDC Senate President helped push these items, alongside discussions on SADC minutes from the Istanbul-based 152nd UIP meeting, and a report on the UIP Governing Council’s decisions from its 218th session to be considered in Arusha. Delegates will also review and adopt a common SADC position on the candidature for UIP presidency at this Assembly. President Sama Lukonde urged robust parliamentary diplomacy, stressing governance in digital technologies and AI and women’s leadership, and a unified voice for SADC. The five-day gathering hosts over 1,500 parliamentarians and will elect a new UIP president; tribute is paid to Dr. Tulia Akson.

triage.headline_ja: 列国議会同盟（IPU）アルーシャ総会：コンゴ東部の平和とエボラが議題に
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はDRCにおける既知のエボラ流行に関する国際政治会議（IPU総会）での議題設定を報じるものであり、新規の疫学的情報（症例数・死亡者数・拡大状況等）を含まないため、新たなシグナルとしての価値は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はタンザニア・アルーシャで開催されたIPU総会における政治的議論（DRC東部の安全保障とエボラ対策）を報じるものであり、エボラ自体の新規発生情報ではない。発生地域にIstanbul/Turkey/Tanzaniaが含まれるが、これらは会議開催地であり感染症発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique Centrale: RDC-France - Reçu par le Président de la République Félix Tshisekedi, le chef de la diplomatie française Jean-noël Barrot promet le soutien de la France à la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Africa: DRC-France - Received by President Félix Tshisekedi, French foreign minister Jean-Noël Barrot promises France's support for the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 2, 2026, in Kinshasa, President Félix Tshisekedi met French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot to discuss bilateral ties, security, and the Ebola response. Barrot confirmed France's substantive contribution to combating the Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Bunia, the epicentre and national response coordination hub for the 17th outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. The outbreak has claimed nearly 4,000 lives. During the visit, Barrot will meet victims of sexual violence, under a protocol signed that morning between France and the DRC addressing impunity and reparations for conflict-related sexual violence in eastern DRC. The French minister reaffirmed France's willingness to support the outbreak response and the security stabilization of the region.

triage.headline_ja: 中部アフリカ：コンゴ民主共和国－フランス－フェリックス・チセケディ大統領に迎えられたフランスのジャン＝ノエル・バロ外相、エボラ対応へのフランスの支援を約束
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（第17次、ブンディブギョ株）で死者数が約4000人に達しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常事態であり、国際支援（フランス）も動員されているためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事自体はフランス外相の外交訪問に関する内容だが、背景にある第17次エボラアウトブレイク（死者約4000人、ブンディブギョ株、東部DRC・ブニア中心）は既存の重大シグナルであり、継続監視・フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - Baisse du nombre de nouveaux cas, assure le ministre de la Santé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - Decrease in the number of new cases, says the Health Minister.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak shows a significant decline in new cases, according to Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba in Kinshasa on Oct 2. Epidemiological indicators show the worst is past and authorities have regained control; transmission is now limited to particular health zones rather than entire provinces. Of 63 health zones under surveillance, 12 have reported no new cases for over 42 days, and eight have had no cases for 22–42 days. As of Sept 29, the response continued in 7 provinces and 63 health zones with 8,224 confirmed Ebola cases. Although some zones still report cases and deaths, figures are trending downward, raising hope for full containment. The minister urged greater transparency in the use of funds allocated for the response, warning that accreditation could be withdrawn if resources are not properly accounted for; populations are urged to maintain preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ出血熱 - 新規症例数が減少、保健大臣が発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2上常に異常・公衆衛生上重大とされる疾患であり、DRCで8,224例の確認症例・継続的な死亡例が報告されているためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する進捗報告。新規症例は減少傾向にあるが、一部地域では依然として感染が継続しており、資金管理の透明性にも懸念が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: مرگ مشکوک یک متخصص آزمایشگاه و احتمال شیوع طاعون
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected death of a laboratory technician and the potential outbreak of plague.
article.articleSummary: Suspected death of a laboratory technician raises fear of plague outbreak in Irkutsk, Siberia. In Sholkhov, a hospital has placed its infectious disease ward under quarantine, with 200 people under medical surveillance. Authorities have not officially confirmed reports of a pneumonic plague case. Conflicting narratives describe two scenarios: one that the deceased woman fell ill after returning from Thailand; the prevailing account identifies the victim as Darya S., a laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Institute of Plague Research, who allegedly damaged a tube containing live plague bacteria while preparing samples and told medical staff before dying. Investigations into possible safety violations have been opened. Governor Igor Kobzov convened a meeting with the health and epidemiology commission; all events in Irkutsk were canceled, and Anna Popova of Russia's health regulator traveled to the region. Plague is rare but treatable with antibiotics; the last known Russian case was in 2016 in Altai.

triage.headline_ja: 検査技師の不審死とペスト流行の可能性
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでペスト研究所の検査技師が肺ペスト感染により死亡した疑いがあり、隔離措置や当局の緊急対応が行われている異常事態であり、IHR基準にも複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツク州での研究所関連ペスト感染疑い事例であり、対象国リストに含まれるThailandは『帰国後発症』という対立する一説にのみ言及されており主題ではないため除外した。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。公式には肺ペスト感染は未確認であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Nord-Kivu: l'épidémie d'Ebola touche désormais 100% du territoire de Lubero avec six nouveaux cas dans le Sud | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | North Kivu: the Ebola outbreak now affects 100% of Lubero Territory with six new cases in the South | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease now affects all seven health zones of Lubero Territory, North Kivu, DRC. On Oct 2, six new EVD cases were confirmed in Kayna and Alimbongo health zones, bringing the district’s tally to seven zones affected and marking the 17th outbreak in the region. Four of the six new patients died; two remain in care. Alimbongo, previously spared, reported four cases; Kayna reported two, signaling a relapse after Kayna had recently declared its only patient cured. Early investigations point to infections linked to contacts from the city of Butembo to the north, highlighting transport corridors' role in spread. Local emergency health teams have strengthened epidemiological surveillance in Kayna and Alimbongo, with rigorous contact tracing underway to interrupt transmission. North previously showed decline (Sept 27-30: seven cases; Biena registered 18 consecutive days without new cases), underscoring Bundibugyo's fragility and the need for vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：エボラ流行がルベロ準州の全域（100％）に拡大、南部で新たに6例確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が拡大し、致死例も発生していることから、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数に該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 本流行はDRC北キブ州の17回目のエボラ発生で、ルベロ準州全7保健地区に拡大。致死率が高く（新規6例中4例死亡）、輸送回廊（ブテンボ経由）を介した拡散リスクが指摘されている。国際的な人的往来への具体的な制限情報は記事中にないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Meningita, holera și ciuma fac ravagii în lume. Date îngrijorătoare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis, Cholera and Plague Ravage the World. Alarming Data.
article.articleSummary: WHO data show meningitis, cholera, and plague continue to threaten health. In 2025, meningitis outbreaks hit the African meningitis belt (Senegal–Ethiopia) with over 20,000 suspected cases and about 1,000 deaths across 24 of 26 belt countries; 2024–2025 data show a 5.9% decline in reported cases where data are available. Vaccination substantially reduced severe meningitis; since 2010 the MenA vaccine cut MenA cases by over 99% among the vaccinated, with none since 2017. Niger launched a 2025 national campaign with a pentavalent meningococcal vaccine. Cholera caused more than 450,000 cases and about 8,000 deaths in 2025 across 47 countries, with deaths up 30% from 2024 and many outside health facilities; Africa worst-hit, with 34% more cases and 58% more deaths than 2024. Plague: 2019–2025 saw roughly 4,000 suspected cases and >400 deaths, concentrated in DRC and Madagascar. Rodent monitoring and rapid outbreak response remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎、コレラ、ペストが世界で猛威を振るう。憂慮すべきデータ公表
triage.triage_reason: WHOの年次統計を基にした髄膜炎・コレラ・ペストの世界的動向まとめ記事であり、特定の新規発生イベントではない。対象国DRCについてもペストの『集中発生地域』として言及されるのみで、具体的な新規症例数や時期は不明。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOの世界統計レビューであり、マダガスカル・エチオピア・ニジェール・セネガルは対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCのみ対象国として該当するが、具体的な新規発生情報は乏しく、続報での確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: भदोही शहर में मिला डेंगू का दो केस, रहें सतर्क
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two dengue cases detected in Bhadohi city; stay vigilant.
article.articleSummary: Two dengue cases detected in Bhadohi city, Uttar Pradesh, prompting district-wide vector-control measures. The health department has launched spraying and fogging at designated sites, along with drainage cleaning and vegetation trimming in urban areas. Across Bhadohi district, 381 gram panchayats are targeted; 165 villages have already undergone spraying, and the remaining 381 villages are slated for fogging soon. In the 2024-25 financial year, the district reported 36 dengue cases. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, which bite during the day. Symptoms include high fever, muscle pain, a rash, and eye pain; severe cases may involve bleeding from the gums, nose, or mouth and vomiting. Diagnosis and treatment are free; the district hospital maintains a 10-bed dengue ward, and each community center runs a five-bed dengue ward. Gyanpur town also emphasizes preventive practices at home and urges medical consultation if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: バドーヒー市でデング熱2例確認、注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地区における小規模なデング熱発生(2例)で、地元保健当局が通常の媒介対策を実施している事例であり、IHR・WPRO基準及び社会的関心ともに特段の該当がない日常的な公衆衛生対応と判断される。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで毎年流行する地域流行性疾患であり、本記事は季節性の通常対応（噴霧・清掃等）を報告する内容。重症例や死亡の報告はなく、前年度の地区内発生数(36件)と比較しても異常な増加は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Emerging and re-emerging diseases are at our doorstep, says Dr. Omoniyi Fagbemi at 2026 Scientific Conference of Guild of Medical Directors
article.articleSummary: 56 diphtheria cases reported in Nigeria including Lagos as of 9 September 2026, highlighting that emerging and re-emerging diseases are at Nigeria's doorstep. At the 2026 Scientific Conference of the Lagos State Branch of the Guild of Medical Directors (2 October 2026, Lagos), Dr. Omoniyi Fagbemi stresses emergency preparedness for such diseases, linking dips in immunization to resurgence. The address recalls the 2014 Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and the Lagos-led containment by Dr. Ameyo Adadevoh and First Consultants Hospital. The event underscores infection prevention and control, and the need to build scalable private healthcare enterprises, with SafeCare Level 3 as minimum; the only SafeCare Level 5 facility in Lagos is a Guild member. The article provides no details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, symptoms, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 「新興・再興感染症は目前に迫っている」—オモニイ・ファグベミ博士、2026年医療ディレクターズギルド科学会議にて発言
triage.triage_reason: 記事はナイジェリアの医療カンファレンスでの講演内容を報じるもので、2014年DRCエボラ流行は過去の事例への言及に過ぎず、現在進行中の発生ではない。ジフテリア症例もナイジェリア（対象国外）の話であり、対象国での現行アウトブレイクに該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（Lagos州）でのジフテリア症例および医療カンファレンスの講演内容。DRCのエボラは2014年の過去の事例として歴史的文脈で言及されているのみで、現行の発生ではない。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: BJP MLA, min spar over dengue spread
article.articleSummary: Two dengue-positive patients died in Kolkata hospitals over the last four days, increasing this year’s dengue deaths to 13 as cases rise in the city. Health officials say the situation is not a broad alarm, but the state remains on yellow alert for the next couple of months. An audit is needed to confirm whether these two deaths were caused by dengue, according to health minister Sharadwata Mukherjee. In Cossipore Ward 2, officials describe the area as worst affected, noting about 30 ponds in need of attention. BJP MLA Ritesh Tiwari criticized civic authorities’ response, while minister Agnimitra Paul said she would visit the area if required. The report highlights ongoing debate over local dengue management amid the yellow-alert status and rising numbers.

triage.headline_ja: BJP州議会議員と大臣、デング熱流行を巡り対立
triage.triage_reason: コルカタでデング熱死亡例が増加し地域的には懸念があるが、公衆衛生当局は「広範な警戒事態ではない」としており、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候もないため、フルRRAに進めるほどの基準は満たさず経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 毎年流行するデング熱の季節的増加と地方政治対立が主題。死因確定のための監査が未実施であり、現時点では地域的な公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Francia promete ayuda financiera a lucha contra ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: France promises financial aid for the fight against Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: France pledges additional funds to fight Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, as Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot visited Bunia in Ituri, the epicenter of the current outbreak. Barrot stressed sustained international action to prevent resurgences and protect Congolese and French alike. In Kinshasa, Health Minister Roger Kamba announced stricter oversight of funds from partners supporting the Bundibugyo-strain response, with coercive measures for organizations that cannot justify expenditures. Only about 25% of the 97 field partners had accounted for their use of funds. The government cited a first three-month plan mobilizing roughly $227 million, with about $99 million remaining unused by partners, and vowed stronger resource-management controls amid broader efforts to reinforce cross-border Ebola preparedness and response.

triage.headline_ja: フランス、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ対策に財政支援を約束
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに関する継続報道であり、国際的な資金支援や国境を越えた予防対策の必要性が強調されているため、フルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事はフランスによる資金支援とDRC政府の資金管理強化に焦点を当てているが、背景にあるイトゥリ州を中心としたエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクは既知の進行中事案であり、継続的な国際支援・越境対応の必要性が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Bareily News: स्वास्थ्य मेले में बुखार के मरीजों की हुई जांच
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bareilly News: Fever patients examined at the health fair.
article.articleSummary: As of 4 October 2026, Bareilly district, Uttar Pradesh, India, health department held health fairs at 81 centers. The events drew patients with fever, cough, stomach issues, and breathing difficulties; malaria testing and other screenings were conducted. Physicians prescribed medicines and advised on preventive measures to curb fever and mosquito-borne diseases. Eligible individuals were issued Ayushman Bharat health cards. The drive promoted awareness of communicable disease control, urging residents to prevent mosquito-borne illnesses by not letting water accumulate around homes. The fairs coincided with weather changes, which increased attendance of patients with fever, cough, abdominal symptoms, and respiratory problems. The initiative emphasizes diagnosis, treatment, and access to health insurance, with a focus on community outreach and preventive guidance.

triage.headline_ja: Bareillyニュース：健康フェアで発熱患者を検査
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性健康啓発活動の報道であり、異常な流行や重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の発熱・マラリア検査を含む定例の健康フェア活動を報じるものであり、特定の流行や異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: RNA with Azvudine incorporated one nucleotide upstream of 3'-end resists cleavage by SARS-CoV-2 proofreading exonuclease
article.articleSummary: Azvudine, a cytidine analog conditionally authorized in China for COVID-19, is taken up by infected cells and converted to azvudine-triphosphate, which inhibits viral polymerases. In SARS-CoV-2, incorporation of Azvudine by the RNA-dependent RNA polymerase hinders the subsequent nucleotide addition, though this effect can be partially overcome by natural nucleotides. 3'-Azv-terminated RNA, however, shows no resistance to the viral proofreading exonuclease (ExoN). Importantly, placing Azvudine at the penultimate RNA position prevents ExoN-mediated cleavage, creating an ExoN-resistant configuration that is less frequent. These results do not single out direct RdRp inhibition as the primary mechanism of Azvudine’s therapeutic effect, but they reveal position-dependent ExoN resistance that could guide development of novel nucleotide analogs aiming to inhibit RdRp and resist coronavirus proofreading. The study provides mechanistic insight as of 2026-10-04.

triage.headline_ja: Azvudineの3'末端から1ヌクレオチド上流への組み込みがSARS-CoV-2校正エキソヌクレアーゼによる切断に抵抗する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はAzvudineの抗ウイルス作用機序に関する基礎研究論文であり、公衆衛生上の緊急イベントではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の感染症発生事例の報告ではなく、薬剤の分子メカニズムに関する基礎科学研究（Nature Scientific Reports誌掲載論文）。特定の国での発生状況を報告するものではないため、発生地域（China）は実際のイベント発生地ではないと判断し、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னையில் 9 மாதங்களில் 4,591 பேருக்கு டெங்கு பாதிப்பு: அரசு செயலா் தகவல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Chennai, 4,591 people infected with dengue in 9 months: government official says.
article.articleSummary: Dengue infections in Chennai city corporation area reached 4,591 in the first nine months of the year, with 1,293 cases detected in September alone. Dr. Thares Ahmed, Secretary of the Tamil Nadu Health and Welfare Department, said the outbreak is under control. To curb transmission, 3,703 personnel were deployed for vector control and 1,251 spraying machines were used to disseminate insecticide. The city has drained all 44 drains and employs drone-based spraying for mosquitoes. Fines of Rs 7.20 lakh were collected from violators responsible for mosquito breeding over the period. The Tamil Nadu government allocated Rs 100 crore to Chennai for monsoon-related works, and Rs 1,200 crore is planned for project works. Public-awareness leaflets on vector control were distributed during the programme.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイで9か月間にデング熱感染4,591人:政府担当者が発表
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は季節性流行で、地元当局が対策を講じ『制御下にある』と発表しているが、症例数が多く今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで季節性に流行する既知の感染症であり、当局が積極的なベクターコントロール対策を実施中。重症度（入院・死亡数）の情報は記事内に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Philippines: Leptospirosis cases top 1,000 in Quezon City
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in the Philippines: Quezon City (QCESD) reports 1,037 cases from January 1 to October 1, 2026, with 66 deaths citywide. Of cases, 709 (68%) are aged 21 and above, and males predominate with 788 cases. Nationwide, the Department of Health (DOH) records 11,965 leptospirosis cases as of late September 2026, with at least 581 deaths, and overall cases running about 46% higher than the same period in 2025, linked to heavy monsoon- and typhoon-related flooding. Leptospirosis is caused by Leptospira bacteria found in dirty floodwaters. The QCESD advises residents to avoid floodwaters, wear protective gear (boots, gloves), keep surroundings clean, and seek medical advice after exposure for possible doxycycline prophylaxis. Data indicate ongoing local transmission in Quezon City alongside a broader national surge associated with flooding.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン：ケソンシティでレプトスピラ症症例が1,000件を超える
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで毎年発生する季節性（モンスーン関連）の風土病であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクは低いが、今年は症例数・死亡者数が前年比46%増と規模が大きいため、国内での推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は洪水時期に毎年フィリピンで発生する風土病。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく動物由来の人畜共通感染症であり、国際的拡大の可能性は低い。ただし2026年は症例数（全国11,965件、死亡581人）が前年同期比46%増と規模が大きく、台風・モンスーンによる洪水の継続があるため、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Francia aumentará su ayuda presupuestaria para combatir el brote de ébola en la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: France will increase its budgetary aid to combat the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: France will propose increasing its budgetary resources to support the fight against the Ebola outbreak declared on May 15 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), during Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot’s visit to Bunia. In forthcoming budget discussions, Paris aims to allocate humanitarian funds to carry the effort to its conclusion, underscoring the need to prevent resurgence and to provide the necessary means to protect both Congolese and French communities. Barrot warned that the disease can seem distant but can evolve rapidly, and highlighted France’s responsibility to equip authorities on the ground with tools and support. He also praised Congolese authorities for containing the outbreak and preventing cross-border spread, and noted ongoing French assistance in research and humanitarian aid.

triage.headline_ja: フランス、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ出血熱流行対策への予算支援を強化へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱流行に対し、フランスが財政支援拡大を表明しており、国際的関心と外部支援の必要性が高いことからフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月15日に宣言されたDRCのエボラ流行に対するフランスの追加支援表明を報じており、国境を越えた拡大は防がれているとされる。フランスはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Naxals fall opens up Bastar for malaria control - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: About 80% of malaria cases in India occur among 20% of the population living in tribal and hilly areas, including Chhattisgarh where 32% reside in tribal/forest zones. The Centre aims to eradicate malaria by 2030. Sukma district collector Amit Kumar said testing has scaled up, with quinine tablets given to affected individuals and artesunate injections for those not recovering on quinine, under the Malaria Mukt Bastar Abhiyan, which reduced case incidence from 17 to 13 in the current period. Sickle cell anaemia is also a concern in the tribal belt, though malaria remains the priority. Officials noted earlier testing was hampered by Naxalite activity; with reduced insurgency, testing has improved, aided by CRPF field hospitals. Security personnel have reached hinterlands, enabling doctors to serve tribals and bolster malaria control in Bastar.

triage.headline_ja: ナクサライトの衰退によりバスタールでマラリア対策が進展 - The Tribune
triage.triage_reason: 既存の風土病に対する対策進展を報じる内容で、症例数は減少傾向にあり、国際的拡大や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの風土病であり、本記事は治安改善に伴う医療アクセス向上とマラリア撲滅プログラムの進捗を報じるもの。症例数は減少しており（17→13）、新興・再興感染症としての異常性やアウトブレイクの兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: As Immunity Falls, Tuberculosis in HIV Wears a Different Face on the Chest
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary TB in advanced HIV patients in southern Vietnam shows non-classic radiographic portraits as CD4 declines. In a cross-sectional study at a tertiary TB and lung disease hospital (Dec 2022–Sept 2023), 92 HIV-positive adults with microbiologically confirmed pulmonary TB were stratified by CD4 count (median 40.5 cells/µL). Radiography differed by immune status: in the highest CD4 stratum, cavitation occurred in all patients with ~90% consolidation and two-thirds large nodules; in the lowest CD4 stratum, cavitation dropped to 3.8%, consolidation to 30.8%, large nodules to 9.6%, and ground-glass opacity appeared in 50%—a pattern linked to Pneumocystis jirovecii co-infection. Ground-glass had unadjusted OR 5.67 for Pneumocystis positivity; 30.4% had at least one additional pulmonary organism. Microbiology: smear positive in 63.3%; Xpert MTB/RIF positive in 91.1% (p<0.0001). Findings emphasize atypical TB in late-presenting, ART-naïve HIV patients and diagnostic challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 免疫力低下に伴い、HIV合併結核の胸部X線像が異なる様相を呈する
triage.triage_reason: 単一医療機関での横断研究に基づく臨床・放射線学的特徴の報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常発生や拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は研究報告（HIV合併結核患者のCD4値による胸部画像所見の違い）であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生緊急事態を示すものではない。地域（ベトナム）は特定の患者コホートに関する臨床研究であり、感染症の異常発生事象ではないためverified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'daki Ebola Salgısını Durduracak İlaç Denemeleri Başladı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drug trials to stop the Ebola outbreak in Congo have begun.
article.articleSummary: More than 250 participants have been enrolled in a trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to test Gilead’s experimental antiviral obeldesivir as post-exposure prophylaxis to curb Bundibugyo Ebola virus spread in Ituri region, eastern DR Congo. The study, which began in July, targets individuals with possible exposure in the past five days who are asymptomatic; half receive a placebo and are monitored daily for 21 days, with immediate supportive care if symptoms develop. Trial coordinator Dr. Guilavogui Jean Paul Yassa notes this approach differs from vaccines, which take time to confer protection. The outbreak has logged over 8,300 confirmed cases and about 4,000 deaths as of May. Health workers are being vaccinated with Ervebo, though its protection against Bundibugyo is unproven. MSF reported a staff member testing positive and evacuated to the Netherlands. WHO says control efforts lag behind the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak, which caused 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行を食い止める薬剤治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部イトゥリ州でのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行は8,300人超の確定症例・約4,000人の死亡という深刻な被害を伴い、国際医療従事者の感染・国外搬送も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事中の死者数（約4,000人）はブンディブギョ型エボラとしては過去に例のない規模であり、数値の正確性について続報確認が必要。オランダ・アンゴラは医療従事者搬送先・周辺情報であり発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil: More than 58,000 dengue cases reported in São Paulo state
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state, Brazil, reports 58,683 confirmed dengue cases since the start of the year, with 42 deaths, 30 of which are under investigation. Of cases, 57,402 are dengue fever, 1,180 dengue with warning signs, and 101 are severe dengue. Warning signs include vomiting, abdominal pain, mucosal bleeding, and other symptoms; severe dengue involves shock or respiratory distress, severe bleeding, or severe organ damage. More than 297,000 suspected cases have been ruled out, and 7,256 remain under analysis due to pending tests or clinical-epidemiological criteria. The situation underscores ongoing transmission risk in the state and highlights the need for surveillance and vector-control measures. Data reflect the calendar year up to 04 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル：サンパウロ州でデング熱患者58,000人以上を報告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで例年発生する季節性デング熱流行であり異常性は低いが、死亡42例・重症例101例を含む大規模発生のため継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する既知の蚊媒介感染症であり、本記事は年間累積データの報告。重症例・死亡例があるため動向注視が必要だが、現時点でIHR通報相当の基準には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola au Congo dépasse les 8 000 cas et approche les 4 000 morts, alors que les attaques contre les agents de santé se multiplient
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 8,000 cases and nears 4,000 deaths, as attacks on health workers mount.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has surpassed 8,000 confirmed cases and 3,924 deaths as of September 27, 2026, across 63 of 167 health zones in seven provinces. The daily bulletin records 78 new cases and 49 deaths, with 34 fatalities never reaching a treatment center. Lab positivity rose to 18.5% nationally, peaking in Ituri at 26.9%. The epidemic is moving, not retreating, with Mandima showing a surge after field assessment. Surveillance remains limited: 31,034 contacts are under active follow-up, with only 74.7% traced and more than 80% of new cases detected among people not followed. Testing has risen eightfold since May, but reach lags transmission. The epicenter shifted southwest along RN4 from Bunia toward Beni, Butembo and Katwa, though Ituri still accounts for about 76% of cumulative cases. Attacks on health workers have intensified, including the killing of Marie-Celestin Karondwa in Butembo and a shooting at a screening post in Vulemba; the Kitatumba treatment center is fully occupied.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が8,000症例を超え死者4,000人に迫る中、医療従事者への攻撃が増加
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が8,000症例・4,000人近い死者を出し拡大継続中で、医療従事者への攻撃により対応能力が損なわれており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: サーベイランス能力の限界（接触者追跡74.7%、新規症例の80%以上が未追跡者から検出）と医療従事者への暴力により、流行制御が著しく困難な状況。既に大規模流行として継続中のためフルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: En RD-Congo, l'immuable guerre contre l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the unrelenting war against the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports an ongoing Ebola outbreak centered in Bunia, where the virus continues to cause daily deaths. The crisis is being addressed at the political level, with Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot visiting Bunia, the outbreak’s epicenter, to underscore international attention. Public messaging features vividly painted signs urging precautions, underscoring persistent community risk. The article emphasizes that Ebola remains active and deadly in the region, highlighting the sustained threat to nearby districts and health facilities. While the piece does not provide laboratory-confirmed case counts or transmission details, the deliberate visit signals ongoing efforts to mobilize political support and public health interventions. The report frames the fight against Ebola in the DRC as an unrelenting war, with local and international actors seeking to curb transmission and reduce mortality.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱との終わりなき戦い
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC・ブニアで継続的に死者を出しており、外相訪問など国際的・政治的関心も高いため、重症度・流行しやすさ・社会的関心の観点からフルRRAに進めるべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事には検査確定症例数や感染経路の詳細が記載されておらず、公式統計との照合が必要。継続的な死亡例と外相訪問から国際的関心の高さがうかがえる。

article.articleHeadline: Health teams intensify flood medical surveys, disease prevention initiatives
article.articleSummary: Lucknow health teams intensified flood relief with medical surveys and disease prevention, especially for water-borne and mosquito-borne diseases. A mobile medical unit in Mallah Tola examined 53 patients during the day, while Chief Medical Officer Dr NB Singh reviewed care in Daud Nagar and Jehta as teams conducted rounds in inundated areas. A 24-hour health camp ensures uninterrupted services, and two unwell residents were evacuated by boat for hospital care. In Kailash Vihar and Hanumantpuram, ASHA and ANM workers carried out door-to-door surveys, distributing medicines, chlorine tablets and ORS to curb floodwater–related infection risks. The department placed 108 ambulances on round-the-clock duty. Municipal commissioner Gaurav Kumar reviewed relief measures in Faizullaganj, inspecting Daud Nagar, Lohra Mau, Hayat Nagar, Gaulat Kheda, Munnu Kheda, Sukhlal Kheda and Saitha, directing continued water pumping, drinking water provision, mobile toilets, anti-larvae spraying, fogging and sanitation, with emphasis on children, elderly and pregnant women.

triage.headline_ja: 保健チームが洪水に伴う医療調査と疾病予防活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、洪水に対する通常の予防的公衆衛生対応（医療調査、消毒、蚊対策等）の記事であり、異常な疾病事象の報告はない。
triage.notes: 疾患名は'Unknown Illness'だが、記事は具体的な感染症の発生ではなく洪水後の予防的保健対応を報じる一般的な内容。地域は特定の病気の発生地として確認できないためverified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito Map: Resistance Genes and Climate Shift Malaria Vectors in Laos
article.articleSummary: Malaria vectors in Lao PDR are more diverse and genetically primed for resistance than presumed. A Parasites & Vectors study, conducted 2017–2019 at four transboundary sites spanning Laos–Cambodia–Thailand, collected 650 Anopheles mosquitoes and used dual molecular markers (COX2 and ITS2) to resolve species identities, uncovering 15 species with strong location-dependent composition. An. kochi (38.46%) and An. sinensis (21.69%) dominated overall catches, highlighting regional variation that can challenge uniform interventions. Among 18 An. peditaeniatus sampled, the team screened two resistance loci: kdr L1014F (no detections) and ace-1 G119S (27.8% GG, 66.7% GS, 5.6% SS). The ace-1 resistance allele averages ~39% frequency, indicating selection by organophosphate/carbamate exposures across border populations. Authors urge border-aware, species-specific vector-control strategies, noting potential outdoor transmission and vector mobility as Laos advances toward malaria elimination in the Greater Mekong Subregion.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊マップ:ラオスにおけるマラリア媒介蚊の抵抗性遺伝子と気候変動
triage.triage_reason: 2017-2019年の学術研究（蚊の種同定・抵抗性遺伝子解析）であり、ヒトの感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はラオス・カンボジア・タイ国境地域での媒介蚊研究であり、対象国リストに該当する国（DRC、タイ等）は発生地域として記載されているが、実際の調査地はラオスであり、対象国リストに含まれない。タイは地名として挙がるが主題国はラオスであるため除外。DRCは本文に言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: 草むらの小さな刺客　欧州だけじゃないダニ媒介感染症
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Tiny Assassin in the Grass: Tick-Borne Diseases Are Not Just in Europe.
article.articleSummary: Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever (CCHF) is a tickborne hemorrhagic fever with no vaccine or specific antiviral; hospitalized mortality ≈30%. Transmission occurs via bites from infected ticks and through contact with blood from infected livestock. The Crimea and Congo in the disease name refer to endemic foci in the Crimea region of Ukraine (now contested) and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. A review across 1944–2024 reports at least 2,746 European cases outside Russia, with country tallies including Bulgaria 1,623; Kosovo 339; Ukraine 336; Croatia 200; Albania 146; Moldova 60; across 17 countries with confirmed outbreaks and risk in 16 more. Tick-borne encephalitis (TBE), the other disease highlighted, is common in eastern Europe and the Baltic region and can cause serious encephalitis. TBE vaccine exists and was approved for use in Japan in 2024; in Hokkaido, Japan, local cases are possible even without international travel, making vaccination relevant for residents and travelers alike.

triage.headline_ja: 草むらの小さな刺客　欧州だけじゃないダニ媒介感染症
triage.triage_reason: CCHFおよびTBEに関する一般的な解説・啓発記事であり、特定の対象国における新規アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生事象を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はCCHF・TBEの疫学的背景や日本（北海道）でのワクチン導入について解説する啓発的内容。DRCは病名の由来（風土病地域）として言及されるのみで、実際の発生事例の主題ではないため対象国リストから除外。欧州（ブルガリア、コソボ、ウクライナ等）が症例数の中心だが対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: החולה שחזר מקונגו נבדק - התוצאה שלילית - אמס MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The patient who returned from Congo was tested - the result is negative - AMS MS.
article.articleSummary: Israel reports a negative Ebola test for a patient who returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo on 2026-10-04; no confirmed Ebola case in Israel. The patient was treated in isolation at Sheba Medical Center as a suspected case, with epidemiological contact tracing under way; those not contacted do not need to take action. Ebola is not airborne; transmission occurs via direct contact with a symptomatic patient or through blood, body fluids, or secretions. Since the Congo outbreak, the Health Ministry has reinforced facilities, PPE, early detection for travelers, and laboratory identification systems. Public guidance urges avoiding nonessential travel to areas with active Ebola in Congo. Returnees who develop fever or symptoms within 21 days should stay home, avoid contact, and call the Health Hotline at 5400.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴから帰国した患者を検査 - 結果は陰性 - AMS MS
triage.triage_reason: イスラエルで疑われたエボラ疑い例は検査の結果陰性であり、新規感染拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されていない。対象国での新規発生情報でもない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイスラエル国内での疑い症例（検査陰性）であり、イスラエルは対象国リストに含まれない。コンゴ（DRC）でのエボラ流行自体への言及はあるが、本記事はその新規発生情報ではなく背景情報としての言及のみのため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 法國外長赴非洲探訪埃博拉疫區
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: French foreign minister visits Ebola-affected region in Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province, Bunia) features prominently as French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot visits Kinshasa and Bunia on Oct 2–3, 2026. The 17th Bundibugyo Ebola wave has exposed more than 8,000 contacts and caused over 4,000 deaths. Barrot toured Bunia’s Rwampara Ebola treatment center run by NGO Alima, which uses transparent ‘bubble’ tents for complex care and deliveries, and visited INRB biomedical research institute led by Prof. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, signaling strengthened international scientific collaboration. Paris aims to increase humanitarian funding to support the outbreak response amid budget discussions. The visit underscores France’s solidarity with DR Congo authorities and comes ahead of France’s National Humanitarian Conference (CNH) scheduled for Oct 6, addressing Congo’s humanitarian and health crisis alongside other global emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: フランス外相、アフリカのエボラ流行地域を訪問
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）第17波が8000人超の接触者と4000人超の死者を出しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際支援（フランスの人道支援強化）が必要な事案であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はフランス外相の訪問を主眼としているが、背景にあるDRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクは死者4000人超・接触者8000人超という極めて深刻な進行中の公衆衛生危機であり、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。France自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 法国外长赴非洲探访埃博拉疫区
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: French Foreign Minister Visits Ebola-Affected Areas in Africa
article.articleSummary: On Oct 2–3, 2026, French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot visited the Ebola-hit eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, focusing on the 17th Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri province’s Bunia. The outbreak has affected more than 8,000 contacts and caused over 4,000 deaths. Barrot’s itinerary included a field visit at Rwampara outside Bunia, one of the outbreak’s hardest-hit sites, where the ALIMA-run treatment center uses transparent “bubble” tents for safe care. He also toured the Institute National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB) laboratories in Bunia, led by virologist Prof. Jean-Jacques Muyembe. He stressed France’s intent to deepen support, including humanitarian funding, as part of budget discussions to intensify efforts at the outbreak’s source. The visit also precedes France’s National Humanitarian Conference in Paris on Oct 6, addressing Congo and other crises.

triage.headline_ja: フランス外相、アフリカのエボラ流行地域を訪問
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で進行中の第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）は接触者8,000人超、死者4,000人超という深刻な規模であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはKigali Province（ルワンダ）、Paris（フランス）が含まれるが、記事はフランス外相の訪問・支援表明に関するものであり、実際の流行地はコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ブニアに限定される。死者数4,000人超・接触者8,000人超という規模はエボラ流行として極めて深刻であり、既存の大規模アウトブレイクの継続状況として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia declara cuarentena en 4 hospitales en Irkutsk, tras muerte de investigadora por "peste neumónica"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia declares quarantine in four hospitals in Irkutsk, following the death of a female researcher from pneumonic plague.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague death prompts a three-week quarantine of four Irkutsk hospitals in Siberia near Lake Baikal. A 28-year-old researcher, Daria Shipilova, from the plague research institute in Shelekhov, was admitted on September 29 with pneumonia of unknown etiology and died two days later. Rumors linked infection to Thailand or a lab spill, but Rospotrebnadzor reports the regional epidemiological situation is stable and analyses found no microorganisms connected to the patient’s professional activity; no other institute employees have needed medical care in the past 10 days. As a precaution, Irkutsk’s aluminum plant director ordered workers to wear respirators. Officials including Governor Igor Kobtsev and health chief Anna Popova coordinated the response. The quarantine underscores heightened surveillance for secondary transmission, though no confirmed secondary cases have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、イルクーツクで研究者が肺ペストで死亡後、4つの病院に検疫隔離を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例が発生し、病院の検疫隔離が行われるなど公衆衛生上重大かつ異常な事例であり、IHR基準を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。タイとの関連は噂に過ぎず、当局は否定的な見解（感染源は研究者の職務活動と無関係）を示しているため、タイは実際の発生国として扱わず verified_locations には含めない。
