article.articleHeadline: 61岁男子喝山泉水后全身重症感染、脓毒性休克！医生：早期像感冒，最怕拖延，致死率最高70%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 61-year-old man develops systemic severe infection and septic shock after drinking mountain spring water! Doctors say: early symptoms resemble a cold; delaying treatment is the biggest danger, with a mortality rate as high as 70%.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-04, a 61-year-old man (alias Lao Yang) developed severe leptospirosis after drinking mountain spring water directly in a flood-affected area following a typhoon. Early symptoms were chest tightness, fatigue, and upper abdominal pain, mistaken for routine overwork and not promptly evaluated. Within days his condition rapidly progressed to septic shock with multi-organ dysfunction, including liver and kidney failure. He was diagnosed with leptospiral infection causing severe sepsis; after aggressive intensive care, infection was controlled and organ function gradually recovered, and he survived. Leptospirosis is a high-risk disease after heavy rain, floods, or outdoor water exposure, often starting with flu-like symptoms and advancing quickly to life-threatening organ damage. In diffuse pulmonary hemorrhagic cases, mortality can reach 50–70%. Prevention emphasizes avoiding unboiled water and, when exposure occurs, informing clinicians of possible exposure to enable early diagnosis and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 61歳男性、山泉水を飲んだ後に全身性重症感染・敗血症性ショックに！医師：初期は風邪に似ているが、治療の遅れが最も危険で致死率は最大70%
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の個別医療啓発記事であり、ヒト-ヒト感染性や集団発生の兆候はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 単一の個別症例報告であり、レプトスピラ症の典型的な感染経路（洪水後の未処理水摂取）による重症化を啓発する医療記事。集団発生やアウトブレイクの情報はなく、地域特定も不十分。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue testing stepped up in Chennai, over 4,500 cases recorded this year
article.articleSummary: As of 05 October 2026, dengue cases in Greater Chennai Corporation have crossed 4,500 this year, with Chennai reporting 4,592 cases from 16,254 tests and no dengue deaths. The Statewide tally stands at about 20,000 cases. All fever cases are being tested to promptly identify dengue. Daily operations include over 100 medical camps and 3,703 mosquito-eradication workers. Drone-based larvicide spraying is being used along the Cooum, and door-to-door awareness campaigns are underway. Desilting of 44 waterways is complete, with 1,400 km of the 1,600 km identified drains desilted; the remaining 200 km will be finished within the week. Chennai has over 3,000 km of stormwater drains, plus 250 km under the Highways Department. ₹100 crore has been allocated for monsoon-prevention works; long-term capital projects may seek World Bank/JICA assistance. Fines totaling ₹7.2 lakh were imposed in the past month for garbage clearance failures.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでデング熱検査を強化、今年の症例数が4,500件を超える
triage.triage_reason: インド・チェンナイで季節性のデング熱流行が報告されているが、死亡者なく地方当局により通常の媒介蚊対策・検査体制で管理されており、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに特段の異常性は見られない。
triage.notes: 死亡例なし、州全体で約2万件の季節性デング熱流行。地方自治体が媒介蚊対策・検査拡充・排水路整備など積極対応中で、外部支援（世界銀行/JICA）は長期インフラ整備目的であり緊急対応ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Penyebaran Influenza A di Sumut Ditemukan 27 Kasus di Sumut, Gejala dan Cara Penanganannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of Influenza A in North Sumatra: 27 Cases Detected, Symptoms and How It Is Managed
article.articleSummary: Influenza A in North Sumatra: 27 cases detected from January–September 2026, with a notable rise reported last month. The North Sumatra Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan Sumut) states these cases come from two sites designated by the Ministry of Health for sentinel surveillance: Puskesmas Teladan, Medan, and RSUD Amri Tambunan, Deliserdang Regency. Influenza A is described as a highly contagious acute respiratory infection caused by the influenza A virus; the article does not detail clinical symptoms. Although case numbers have increased, officials describe the situation as safe for now and call for continued vigilance. The 27 cases reflect sentinel surveillance data available from the two facilities; there may be additional cases in Sumut hospitals not captured in this report. No information is provided on vaccination, infection source, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 北スマトラでインフルエンザA型が拡大、27例確認—症状と対処法
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常のサーベイランス報告であり、当局も「安全」と評価しているが、症例増加傾向のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの定点サーベイランスデータに基づく報告で、重症度や死亡例の記載はない。地方当局は状況を管理可能としている。

article.articleHeadline: Antraks Ditemukan di Gunungkidul, Kementan Perkuat Pengendalian Ternak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anthrax Found in Gunungkidul, Ministry of Agriculture Strengthens Livestock Control
article.articleSummary: Anthrax cases were detected in Kalurahan Dadapayu, Kapanewon Semanu, Kabupaten Gunungkidul, Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta, with laboratory samples testing positive for Bacillus anthracis. The Ministry of Agriculture, with the Gunungkidul Regency and field animal health officers, strengthened animal-health controls. Lab confirmation provides fast, precise management and underpins cross-sector coordination for a zoonosis response. An epidemiological investigation by the Gunungkidul Agriculture and Food Service on Sept 11 traced the event, assessed nearby livestock, and collected samples. Disinfection of affected barns, treatment for sick animals, and vitamins for surrounding healthy stock followed; on Sept 14, 88 goats and 11 cows received antibiotics and vitamins. Anthrax vaccination started Sept 28 to boost protection and reduce future risk. Ongoing surveillance includes market health checks, decontamination evaluation, and environmental re-sampling. Human health sector involvement remains essential due to zoonotic transmission.

triage.headline_ja: グヌンキドゥルで炭疽菌確認、農業省が家畜管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのグヌンキドゥルで家畜の炭疽菌感染が確認され防疫対応が行われているが、現時点でヒトへの感染拡大や重症例の報告はなく、地域限定的な家畜衛生事案に留まる。
triage.notes: 炭疽菌はインドネシアの一部地域で毎年発生する風土病的事案であり、家畜への対応（消毒・抗生物質投与・ワクチン接種）が実施されている。ヒトへの感染例は記事中で明示されていないが、人獣共通感染症としての監視は継続されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue testing stepped up in Chennai, over 4,500 cases recorded this year
article.articleSummary: Dengue testing stepped up in Chennai as Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) areas report over 4,500 dengue cases this year, including 1,293 in September. Authorities have held more than 100 medical camps daily and deployed 3,703 mosquito-eradication workers to curb transmission. The Health Department has directed that all fever cases be tested for dengue to improve detection. Principal Secretary to Government, Health and Family Welfare Department, Darez Ahamed, said the directive reflects urgent containment needs in GCC. The intensified response follows an urban dengue push in Chennai, with expanded vector-control measures and fever-testing protocols to identify and isolate infections promptly. As of October 4, 2026, the outbreak is being actively managed with intensified vector control and fever testing.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでデング熱検査を強化、今年の症例数4,500件超を記録
triage.triage_reason: インドの流行地であるチェンナイでの季節性デング熱の増加であり、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はないが、媒介動物を介した感染拡大リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: チェンナイ（タミル・ナードゥ州）はデング熱の流行地であり、今回の報告は季節的な症例増加と当局による対応強化（発熱症例の全数検査、防疫活動員の増員）を示す内容。重症度（入院・死亡）の具体的情報は記事に含まれておらず不明。

article.articleHeadline: Berawal Dari Santap Daging Kambing Mati, Warga Gunungkidul Terkena Antraks
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Starting from eating the meat of a dead goat, Gunungkidul residents contracted anthrax.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax outbreak linked to consumption of meat from a dead goat in Gunungkidul Regency, Yogyakarta Special Region, Indonesia. In Padukuhan Palem, Kalurahan Dadapayu, Kapanewon Semanu, seven residents had direct contact with a goat that died suddenly, prompting an investigation. PCR testing confirmed four of the seven as anthrax cases. Bacillus anthracis, a soil-dwelling bacterium, can infect grazing livestock and transmit to humans via three routes: cutaneous (through skin contact with infected animal parts), gastrointestinal (eating undercooked meat), and inhalational (during processing of animal hides). Authorities warn that consuming meat from animals that died suddenly can cause anthrax. Ismono, head of Gunungkidul Health Office, noted the four positive cases and that the investigation followed exposure to the goat. The report highlights risks of slaughtering and consuming dead livestock and the role of laboratory confirmation in identifying cases.

triage.headline_ja: 死んだヤギの肉を食べたことから始まり、グヌンキドゥル住民が炭疽菌に感染
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで散発的に発生する人獣共通感染症（炭疽菌）の事例で、4名の感染が確認されているが、死亡例や人-人感染の報告はなく、地域限定の公衆衛生対応で管理可能と思われる。ただし、家畜由来の曝露が継続する可能性があり、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: インドネシアでは炭疽菌（Anthrax）は家畜由来の風土病的な感染症として毎年散発的に報告されており、本事例も死亡した家畜の肉の摂取・接触による典型的なパターン。PCR検査で4例が確定されているが、重症度や死亡例についての記載はない。地域保健当局（Gunungkidul Health Office）が対応しており、国際的な拡大リスクは低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists Propose Framework to Test Whether Oropouche Virus Harms Fetuses
article.articleSummary: Brazil's 2024 re-emergence of Oropouche virus prompted a proposed framework in BMC Infectious Diseases to test for fetal harm. While vertical transmission and adverse fetal outcomes have accumulated in reports, robust causal inference lags. Case reports show Oropouche RNA or antigens in placental/fetal tissues and anti-Oropouche IgM in microcephalic newborns, but active replication in fetal tissue remains unproven. The framework combines molecular diagnostics and histology to prove replication: strand-specific RT-PCR for positive-sense RNA, RNAscope with confocal microscopy, PrimeFlow RNA with flow cytometry, and immunohistochemistry for non-structural proteins. Animal models include mice with intact or impaired interferon signaling (noting prior fetal effects in interferon-deficient contexts), golden hamsters as a potentially permissive model, and non-human primates; intrauterine infection as proof-of-concept, plus intracranial inoculation or embryonated eggs. Emphasizes using diverse lineages, minimal passaging, and gestational timing to assess risk to fetuses.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者らがオロプーシェウイルスの胎児への影響を検証するための研究枠組みを提案
triage.triage_reason: 新規の発生・アウトブレイク情報ではなく、既知の2024年ブラジルでのオロプーシェ再興を踏まえた研究手法（胎児への影響評価フレームワーク）の学術的提案記事であるため。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の新規症例急増やアウトブレイクを報告するものではなく、先天性オロプーシェ感染の因果関係を証明するための研究手法提案に関する学術記事。続報があれば実際の症例データとして再評価の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Jalandhar logs 28 dengue cases; rural areas most affected - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Jalandhar, India reports 28 dengue cases this year, rural areas (16) bear higher burden than urban (12). One active case on Saturday; no dengue deaths to date. Vector-control teams intensified surveillance, surveying 356,278 houses and inspecting 826,968 containers; larvae detected in 1,102 houses and 1,144 containers. On Saturday, 1,708 houses and 3,548 containers were checked; larvae found in five houses and five containers. Authorities issued 67 pre-challans and three rural challans to deter breeding; pre-challans warn residents to remove standing water. Dr Aditya, District Epidemiologist, emphasizes source reduction and weekly removal of stagnant water. Lab: 8,778 dengue samples tested; two chikungunya cases detected with 150 samples tested so far. No deaths reported.

triage.headline_ja: ジャランダルでデング熱28例を記録、農村部で被害大 - The Tribune
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域における例年レベルの季節性デング熱・チクングニヤ熱報告であり、死亡例もなく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体のベクターコントロール対応は通常の公衆衛生活動の範囲内であり、死亡例もなく重症度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: উৎসবের মুখেই উদ্বেগ বাড়িয়ে ১০ হাজারের দিকে ডেঙ্গু রোগীর সংখ্যা
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue patients near 10,000 as the festival approaches
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in West Bengal near 9,500 as Puja festival approaches; health department reports a sharp rise in dengue infections, now exceeding 9,500. A dengue-related death occurred in Howrah district's Domjur area: a 56-year-old widow with chronic kidney disease died after mild fever and rapid deterioration; officials say the death was not solely due to dengue. Malaria infections (vivax and falciparum) are also rising, pushing total malaria cases past 10,000. The districts of concern include Kolkata, South 24 Parganas, Howrah, Murshidabad, and Purulia; dengue sits highest in Murshidabad, second in Kolkata, followed by North 24 Parganas, South 24 Parganas, Nadia, and Hooghly. Authorities cite sanitation as key, amid criticism of Howrah district's ongoing cleanliness efforts as dengue and malaria surge.

triage.headline_ja: 祭りを前にデング熱患者数が1万人に迫り懸念が拡大
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州でデング熱・マラリアが季節的に急増し死亡例も出ているが、例年起こりうる風土病的流行であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: デング熱・マラリアともに西ベンガル州（コルカタ、ハウラー、ムルシダバードなど）で季節的に毎年発生する風土病であり、今回の報告も例年のパターンに沿う可能性が高い。死亡例は基礎疾患（慢性腎疾患）を有する高齢女性で、デング熱単独が死因でないとされている。

article.articleHeadline: City Life Reshapes the Microbes Inside Thailand's Brown Dog Ticks
article.articleSummary: Thailand's brown dog tick, Rhipicephalus linnaei, collected from dogs across five provinces (urban and rural) in a study of 131 ticks, reveals a microbiome dominated by a vertically transmitted bacterium, Candidatus Coxiella mudrowiae, present in all ticks. Using Oxford Nanopore sequencing of full-length 16S rRNA, researchers show geography, habitat type, and blood-feeding status shape the tick microbiome. Urban ticks exhibit lower bacterial diversity than rural ones. Engorged ticks likewise show altered microbial communities compared with unfed or partially fed ticks, potentially affecting vector competence for pathogen transmission. The bacterium is related to Coxiella, the agent of Q fever, implying close evolutionary ties. The work, led by Artharee Rungrojn and partners from Mahidol University, Chulalongkorn University, Vet Research Center, CNRS, and Oxford, highlights how environment and host interactions mold microbial ecosystems within ticks, with implications for veterinary and public health in Thailand.

triage.headline_ja: 都市生活がタイのクリイロコイタマダニの微生物叢を変える
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はダニの微生物叢に関する基礎研究であり、ヒトまたは動物における実際のQ熱感染事例の報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はダニのマイクロバイオーム研究に関する学術的内容であり、Q熱の発生事例は報告されていないため、感染症サーベイランスのシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളം ‍ഡ‍െങ്കി പിടിയിൽ; മഴക്കാലത്തുമാത്രമല്ല, വർഷം മുഴുവൻ നിലനിൽക്കുന്നു; മുൻവർഷത്തെക്കാൾ രോഗികൾ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kerala in the grip of dengue; not only during the monsoon, it persists year-round; more patients than last year.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever remains a year‑round threat in Kerala, with 11,281 confirmed cases and 42 deaths as of September 24, 2026, and 2025 records show 10,886 cases and 56 deaths. January recorded 378 cases; June peaked at 1,802 cases with 15 deaths; by September 24, the first 24 days added 1,330 cases. All four dengue virus serotypes (DENV-1–DENV-4) circulate in the state, raising the risk of severe disease on sequential infection. Historical data show 2022: 4,432 cases/29 deaths; 2023: 17,426/153; 2024: 20,674/128; 2025 about half of earlier years but rising in 2026. Aedes mosquitoes breed in stagnant water; a 2025 survey across Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam, Kozhikode, Wayanad, and Idukki found 78% of breeding sites are human-made. Mosquitoes bite during the day; protect homes and workplaces from intrusion. Dr. S. S. Lal, Chairman, Infectious Disease Control High Authority Committee, stresses source reduction.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でデング熱の猛威続く；雨季だけでなく年間を通じて発生、昨年より患者数増加
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州における季節性デング熱の継続的流行で死亡例もあるが、例年発生している既知の状況であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、フルRRAには進めず経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はケララ州で例年発生している風土病的感染症であり、4つの血清型が同時流行している点は重症化リスクを高めるが、国際的な新規性や緊急性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Floodwater and Sewage in Thailand: Health Risks and Safety Tips
article.articleSummary: Thailand floodwater can appear harmless but may harbor sewage, animal waste, chemicals, or other pollutants. Health risk depends on exposure: swallowing contaminated water can trigger gastrointestinal illness, while germs can enter through open wounds. To reduce risk, avoid wading when possible, wear rubber boots and gloves, cover cuts with waterproof bandages, and wash exposed skin with soap and clean water; follow local guidance on drinking water and food. Infections linked to floodwater include diarrheal illness from E. coli and Salmonella, and wound infections from dirty water or soil; leptospirosis can occur after contact with contaminated water or mud. Melioidosis is a region-specific concern in the US Gulf Coast but is noted in floodwater discussions. Watch for diarrhea, vomiting, stomach cramps, fever, skin rash, or wound redness, swelling, drainage, and worsening pain; seek medical care for illness or serious wounds and consider tetanus vaccination updates. Children should stay out of floodwater and toys should be disinfected.

triage.headline_ja: タイの洪水と下水：健康リスクと安全対策
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の一般的な健康注意喚起記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや症例報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は洪水時の一般的な健康リスク啓発・予防策の解説記事であり、タイ国内での具体的な感染症の発生やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。メリオイドーシスについても米国湾岸地域の話として言及されており、タイでの実際の症例報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Red Cross Driver Dies After Ebola Response Mission in DRC
article.articleSummary: Ismael Mulindwa, a driver for the Uganda Red Cross Society, died after almost a month of treatment following deployment to the Democratic Republic of Congo to support the Ebola response. URCS confirmed his death and said the Red Cross team was attacked during the Ebola operation. Mulindwa was buried in Kabimbiri, off Kayunga Road, in Uganda. His death comes just over a month after Uganda was declared Ebola-free by the World Health Organization, marking the end of its Ebola outbreak response. Mulindwa was described as a dedicated ambulance worker who touched many lives and contributed to community relief efforts. The report links his death to service connected with the Ebola response in DRC and notes the attack on the response team; the article does not provide laboratory confirmation or a defined infection source.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ赤十字の運転手、DRCでのエボラ対応任務後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ対応中に『襲撃された』との記述があり死因が感染かどうか不明確で、検査確認もないため、続報を注視する段階と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ赤十字の運転手がDRCでのエボラ対応任務中に死亡したと報じているが、死因が感染によるものか『襲撃』によるものか明確でなく、検査確認の記載もない。ウガンダは既にWHOによりエボラ終息宣言済みであり、本件が新たな感染拡大を示すものかは不明。ザンビアは発生地域リストに含まれるが本文中で言及がないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Plague outbreak: How ancient teeth help scientist decode deadly disease took place 5,500 years ago
article.articleSummary: Ancient DNA from teeth in four Siberian burial sites near Lake Baikal reveals the oldest-known Yersinia pestis strains, dating to about 5,500 years ago and signaling two prehistoric plague outbreaks. The study finds the disease disproportionately affected children and adolescents, with several child graves showing plague DNA in the remains; two young girls aged 9–10 and 5–6, and an 11–12-year-old boy shared in the vicinity, plus a non-related aunt-nephew pair buried nearby. The researchers trace transmission from marmots—likely via raw organ consumption or contact with infected hides—and between people by coughing and sneezing. Ancient plague differed from the later bubonic form; some genetic traits in these strains are not in today’s pathogen. The findings, published in Nature, place plague origins in central/northern Asia and imply early spread across Eurasia.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト発生：古代の歯がどのように5,500年前の致死性疾患の解明に役立ったか
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は古代DNA研究に関する歴史的・学術的内容であり、現代における公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は5,500年前の古代シベリア（バイカル湖周辺）の考古学的・遺伝学的研究に関するもので、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。発生地域にThailandやRussiaが含まれるが、記事内容とは無関係（Bluedotの誤分類）。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus influenza A 'meningkat' di Indonesia, seberapa parah gejalanya?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases have increased in Indonesia; how severe are the symptoms?
article.articleSummary: Influenza A activity has risen in Indonesia and across Southeast Asia, but surveillance through week 38 of 2026 classifies the situation as moderate and not yet alarming. Epidemiologist Masdalina Pane criticizes government messaging, noting a COVID-era warning framework is missing. In Mataram, West Nusa Tenggara, residents report influenza-like illness with severe headaches, joint pain, fever and fatigue. Beni Permana, 37, began symptoms on Sep 19; he did not test, used over-the-counter meds and vitamin D3, recovering after a few days though coughing persisted; his wife and child were affected, and a coworker Wahyu became ill after contact. In Bandung, Nia Kurniati and family were diagnosed with influenza A without swab confirmation, experiencing myalgia, shortness of breath, cough, and headaches. Bandung's health office notes rising Influenza-Like Illness; 40 influenza A cases were detected via sentinel ILI testing at Puskesmas Padasuka. Week 36–37 in Mataram: ISPA/influenza cases rose from 2,244 to 2,639.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアでインフルエンザA症例が「増加」、症状の重さは？
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでインフルエンザA/ILI症例が増加しているが、サーベイランス上は「中等度」でアラームレベルには達しておらず、重症度や国際的拡大の証拠は不明なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの増加であり、新型株やH5N1等の異常性を示す情報はない。専門家は政府の警戒メッセージング不足を指摘しており、社会的関心はあるが、確定診断（スワブ検査）なしの症例報告が多く、重症度の実態は不明確。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات "إيبولا" بالكونغو إلى 8376 حالة وتحذيرات من انتشاره بإفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo rise to 8,376, with warnings about its spread in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 8,376 cases with 4,042 deaths as of October 5, 2026, per the DRC Ministry of Health (Kinshasa). Africa CDC Director-General Jan Kasia warned the ongoing spread within the country poses a threat to neighboring African states. During a visit to the DRC, French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot pledged increased support to eliminate the outbreak and cautioned that surveillance lapses could trigger a rapid resurgence. The United Nations called for additional resources to bolster response efforts, and the WHO had previously declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting elevated regional risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数8,376人に上昇、アフリカ全域への拡大警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ感染が8,376例・死亡4,042例に達し、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み、周辺国への拡大リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準の複数に該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: フランスは支援表明国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。WHOはすでにPHEICを宣言済みとの記述あり。致死率約48%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا بالكونغو إلى 8376 حالة وتحذيرات من انتشاره بإفريقيا - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo rise to 8,376 and warnings about its spread in Africa - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo is grappling with a continuing Ebola virus disease outbreak. As of 5 October 2026, the Ministry of Health reports 8,376 Ebola cases and 4,042 deaths, with transmission continuing across the country and warnings that neighboring nations are at risk. United Nations appeals for additional resources to combat the outbreak, and the World Health Organization previously designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May, due to escalating regional risk. France pledged increased support during a visit to Kinshasa, with Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barro cautioning that faltering surveillance could hasten a resurgence. The report underscores cross-border threat and the need for sustained control measures to prevent further spread into Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が8,376人に上昇、アフリカでの拡大に警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がPHEICに指定され、症例・死者数が増加し続けており、周辺国への拡大懸念と国際支援の要請がある深刻な事態であるため。
triage.notes: WHOにより2026年5月にPHEIC宣言済み。フランスが支援表明、国連も追加資源を要請しており、国際的関心が極めて高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Fidson Selected to Expand Influenza Treatment Access, Pandemic Preparedness
article.articleSummary: Influenza antiviral baloxavir marboxil will be developed as generic versions under MPP's voluntary license with Roche; Fidson Healthcare Plc is selected as one of eleven manufacturers across nine countries to sign sublicences, expanding production across regions including Brazil, China, and India. The move aims to diversify manufacturing capacity and strengthen pandemic preparedness by enabling rapid, quality-assured access to baloxavir. MPP Executive Director Charles Gore said implementation with manufacturers is underway to support product development and regulatory approval to make generics available quickly, combining global capacity with regionally focused production for a geographically diverse, resilient supply base. Roche VP Tamara Schudel called the milestone, noting that voluntary partnerships are critical for pandemic preparedness and rapid response.

triage.headline_ja: フィドソン、インフルエンザ治療アクセス拡大とパンデミック対応力強化のため選定される
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、抗インフルエンザ薬のジェネリック製造ライセンス契約に関する企業・保健政策ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事は医薬品製造ライセンス契約（MPPとRocheのbaloxavir marboxilジェネリック化）に関するもので、疾病発生事例ではない。ブラジル・中国・インドは製造拠点として言及されているのみで、感染症アウトブレイクの発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 世界の関心が薄れたエボラ出血熱、対策組織が抱くかつてない危機感
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola hemorrhagic fever, whose global attention has waned, faces an unprecedented sense of crisis among response organizations.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola hemorrhagic fever in the Democratic Republic of Congo is expanding toward the largest recorded outbreak, with over 7,000 cases since May and roughly half deaths. Uganda had contained its outbreak earlier, but in DRC the situation remains unstable amid ongoing conflict, with millions displaced and complicating contact tracing. External aid workers face distrust, and local residents have attacked Red Cross volunteers, damaged ambulances, and hindered safe burial teams. Vaccination is deemed essential to ending the outbreak. CEPI has mobilized about $100 million to accelerate vaccine development, enabling Serum Institute of India to manufacture the Oxford University–developed ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine, while Moderna vaccine candidates enter safety and efficacy testing; trials are expected to begin this month, provided tracing capacity allows. Experts warn it could become the worst Ebola outbreak in history if not controlled.

triage.headline_ja: 世界の関心が薄れたエボラ出血熱、対策組織が抱くかつてない危機感
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が過去最大規模に拡大しており、7000例超・致死率約50%、紛争による追跡困難という深刻かつ異常な状況でIHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既に流行を収束させた過去の事例として言及されており、現在の主題はDRCのみ。インドはワクチン製造拠点（Serum Institute of India）としての言及であり発生国ではないため除外。記事見出しでは「世界の関心が薄れた」とあるが、本文は対策組織側の危機感の高まりを報じている。

article.articleHeadline: કચરો ઉપડે છે પણ ટોપલી સાફ કરાતી નથી, સ્થાનિકો પરેશાન: બિનઆરોગ્યપ્રદ સ્થિતિ! તંત્રની બેદરકારીના કારણે ગાંધીગ્રામ આવાસમાં રોગચાળાની ભીતિ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Garbage is piling up, but the dustbin isn’t being cleaned; locals distressed: unsanitary conditions! Threat of an outbreak in Gandhigram Housing due to administrative negligence.
article.articleSummary: Rajkot's Gandhigram area, Nanavati Chowk Avas Yojana quarters, faces unsanitary conditions as garbage beneath and inside waste bins remains uncleansed. Municipal sanitation workers clear surface rubbish daily, but entrenched waste at bin bases rots, emitting a foul odor and attracting pests. The accumulating filth has raised concerns of rising mosquitoes, lizards, and other pests, with dengue, malaria, and other mosquito-borne diseases deemed a plausible threat. Residents question whether municipal health authorities’ negligence could trigger a major outbreak and have demanded immediate bin cleaning and regular fumigation/disinfection. They argue that surface cleaning is insufficient; proper sanitation and routine insecticide spraying at bin sites are essential. If an outbreak occurs, accountability remains disputed, and residents urge authorities to urgently sanitize and disinfect the waste bins to mitigate public health risk.

triage.headline_ja: ゴミは回収されるが集積所が清掃されず、住民困惑：不衛生な状況！行政の怠慢によりガンディグラム住宅地で感染症流行の懸念
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、ゴミ処理の不備による蚊媒介性疾患の潜在的リスクについての住民の懸念を報じる記事であり、具体的な症例報告がない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の感染症流行ではなく、衛生インフラの不備（ゴミ処理）に対する住民の苦情と、それに伴うデング熱・マラリアなど蚊媒介性疾患発生の懸念を報じるもの。実際の症例報告は確認されていないため、対象国リストへの該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Angels Of Indore: Brother's Death From TB Inspires Dr Dilip Sharma's 23-Year Mission To Save Thousands
article.articleSummary: TB in Indore, Madhya Pradesh: Dr Dilip Sharma, nodal for Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme, has spent 23+ years since 2003 at Depalpur Community Health Centre. Covering about 460 villages in Indore district (Sanwer, Hatod, Depalpur blocks), he has ensured early diagnosis, treatment, and completion under DOTS, with free medicines reaching around 20,000 patients. Treatment records are on Nikshay. Inspired by his mother Bharti Devi after his elder brother Rajesh died of TB meningitis, he aims to End TB in his lifetime: TB Harega, Desh Jeetega. Depalpur block has topped Indore district TB-free Gram Panchayats for 2023-2025, per Dr Vibha Nagar.

triage.headline_ja: インドールの天使:結核で亡くなった兄がディリップ・シャルマ医師の23年にわたる救命活動の原動力に
triage.triage_reason: 医師の人道的活動を紹介する人間味のある記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 既存の結核対策プログラム（National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme）の活動紹介記事であり、新規の感染拡大や異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Cases Reach 8,376 Amid Regional Concerns
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 8,376 confirmed cases and 4,042 deaths, according to Congolese health authorities as of 05 Oct 2026. Ongoing transmission in the DRC sustains risk to neighbouring countries amid population movement and cross-border spread. Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya warns of regional risks as transmission continues. French Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs Jean-Noël Barrot, visiting the DRC, reaffirmed France's support and emphasized vigilance to prevent a resurgence of transmission. The World Health Organization (WHO) warns that sustained transmission in the DRC poses a cross-border risk, with neighbouring nations facing heightened risk due to cross-border movement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ症例数が8,376人に到達 地域的懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: エボラの大規模流行（8,376症例、4,042死亡）が継続中で、WHOやアフリカCDCが越境拡大リスクを警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。致死率は約48%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Spring gardening warning as Legionnaires threat lurks
article.articleSummary: Legionnaires' disease (legionellosis) dominated the South Island in the past year, with 54 of 152 nationally notified cases from September 2025 to August 2026. Health NZ reports 46 South Island patients hospitalised, contributing to 135 total hospitalisations nationwide. Regional distribution covers South Island (Nelson-Marlborough, Canterbury, South Canterbury, West Coast, Otago and Southland); Northern region (Northland and Auckland) with 49 cases and 46 hospitalisations; Midland (Waikato, Bay of Plenty, Taranaki, Tairāwhiti) with 38 cases and 32 hospitalisations; Central region (Hawke’s Bay to Wellington) with 11 cases, all hospitalised. Health officials advise gardeners to wear gloves and a well-fitting N95 mask, handle potting mix outdoors or in well-ventilated areas, dampen soil to reduce dust, and wash hands after gardening. Legionella thrives in moist environments; symptoms include flu-like illness such as cough, fever, shortness of breath, and others; seek medical advice if symptoms occur after exposure to potting mix."}{

triage.headline_ja: 春のガーデニング注意喚起：レジオネラ症（在郷軍人病）の脅威が潜む
triage.triage_reason: ニュージーランド国内のレジオネラ症（土壌・堆肥由来）に関する季節性の公衆衛生注意喚起であり、対象国に該当する発生国がなく、国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はニュージーランドの園芸用培養土由来のレジオネラ症に関する季節的注意喚起であり、Philippines・Gambia・US等の地域タグは記事本文に実質的な言及がなく、発生地域としては確認できない。対象国（GeoNames ID）リストに該当する発生国なし。

article.articleHeadline: दुनिया रहे तबाही को तैयार? लैब से निकला 'कोरोना' का भाई, रूस में हो गया वुहान वाला कांंड
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the world ready for disaster? The lab-origin 'brother of coronavirus'—a Wuhan-like incident occurred in Russia.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 October 2026, Russia’s Siberia region near Irkutsk reports a mysterious infection following a laboratory incident at the Shelekhov Anti-Plague Research Institute. The infection is described as a 'lab-origin brother of coronavirus' and Wuhan-like, but pathogen identity has not been established. The incident has caused concern and panic among officials. A researcher working at the anti-plague institute died after the event, underscoring potential exposure risks. No laboratory confirmation details, case counts, or symptoms are provided in the report. The piece links to broader fears and recalls the devastating pandemic of 2021, presenting this as a similar, unsettled scenario in Russia. Timing details remain undisclosed.

triage.headline_ja: 世界は大惨事に備えているのか？研究所から漏れた『コロナの兄弟』―ロシアで武漢のような事件が発生
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの研究所で原因不明の感染が発生し研究者が死亡したとされるが、病原体の特定情報や症例数などが一切示されておらず、信頼性の低いセンセーショナルな単一メディア報道にとどまるため、続報を注視する段階と判断する。
triage.notes: 本件はロシア・イルクーツク州のシェレホフ抗ペスト研究所での事案であり、対象国リスト（中国含む）には該当しない。記事中の武漢・中国への言及は比較表現であり、実際の発生地ではないため China は verified_locations から除外した。病原体不明、症例数不明、情報源もタブロイド的なヒンディー語メディア単独であり、信頼性・一次情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ死者4000人超え、コンゴ史上最悪　東部で感染拡大
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll tops 4,000, the worst in Congo's history, as infections spread in the east.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports the worst Ebola virus disease outbreak on record, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. As of Oct 2, 2026, government statistics show 4,018 deaths and 8,300 laboratory-confirmed infections across seven provinces, with more than 2,000 recoveries. Globally, the outbreak is small compared with the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic, which infected about 28,600 and killed over 11,000. In the northeast, Ituri province shows some signs of slowing, while the eastern regions continue rapid spread. North Kivu remains affected, and in September South Ubangi declared an outbreak, becoming the seventh province involved. The response centers on containment, surveillance, and laboratory confirmation to curb transmission linked to the Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死者4000人超え、コンゴ史上最悪　東部で感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で死者4000人超、7州に拡大しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではコンゴ国内（Ituri、North Kivu、South Ubangiなど7州）のみが言及されており、Angolaへの拡大は記載されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ജി​ല്ല​യി​ല്‍ ഡെ​ങ്കി​പ്പ​നി​യും പ​ക​ര്‍​ച്ച​പ്പ​നി​യും പ​ട​രു​ന്നു | Deepika | The Largest Read Malayalam Internet Daily | Online News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever and chikungunya fever spread in the district.
article.articleSummary: Kollam district in Kerala reports concurrent spread of dengue fever and chikungunya fever. Over two weeks, 234 samples from government hospitals were tested; 130 were positive for dengue. On the 29th, 17 samples were tested, with 10 confirmed dengue cases. New infections were confirmed in Chithar, Ayil, Kottankara, Mundakkal, Neendakar, and Thrikkadavoor, with five cases in Sakthikulangara. An Adichanalloor resident also tested positive. Private hospitals report higher numbers, but government figures are not available. Health authorities urge residents to guard homes and fields against dengue and seek prompt treatment if symptoms appear. Mosquitoes breed in standing water; remove breeding sites. Clean household vessels, ice boxes, food packets, utensils, tires, and rubbers around homes to reduce breeding.

triage.headline_ja: 県内でデング熱とチクングニア熱が蔓延
triage.triage_reason: ケーララ州コラム県でデング熱・チクングニア熱の季節性流行が報告されているが、重症度や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、情報も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はケーララ州コラム県での地域的なデング熱・チクングニア熱の流行報告であり、インド南部で毎年見られる季節性感染症の一環と考えられる。スリランカ北部州やウッタル・プラデーシュ州は発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文では言及されていないため除外した。死亡者数や重症患者数の情報がなく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響度は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão contra a dengue passa por 20 quarteirões do Portão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anti-Dengue Campaign Passes Through 20 Blocks in Portão
article.articleSummary: Dengue control campaign 'Curitiba sem Mosquito' moves through the Portão Regional in Curitiba, Brazil this week. Health agents conduct on-site educational briefings to explain prevention measures. During the action, they educate residents on dengue prevention and proper disposal of debris, with collection by trucks from the Municipal Secretariat of Environment. The operation covers 20 blocks in the Fazendinha neighborhood. Residents will be advised tomorrow and Wednesday, with collection scheduled for Thursday. For pickup, residents should place debris outside their homes on the day the trucks pass. Residents are urged to participate and ensure debris is placed outside on the designated day to maximize pickup efficiency.

triage.headline_ja: ポルタン地区の20区画でデング熱対策キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防啓発・清掃活動に関する記事であり、異常な流行や重症化、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はクリチバ市による定期的なデング熱予防・環境整備キャンペーンの実施報告であり、症例数や流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Chennai Dengue Cases Cross 20,000; Health Officials Say Trend Declining
article.articleSummary: Chennai dengue cases have crossed 20,000 this year, though authorities say the situation is stabilising and new infections are declining. Current data show 4,592 dengue cases with 16,254 tests conducted and 1,293 cases in September; no deaths. The higher figure reportedly reflects broader fever testing. Health Secretary Tariq Ahmed emphasised testing all fever cases and prompt clinical management. The Greater Chennai Corporation has 3,703 mosquito-control workers, runs over 100 fever clinics daily, and uses about 1,250 larvicide-spraying machines; drone-based larvicide spraying is underway in the Cooum river. Fines totaling Rs 7.2 lakh were issued for garbage disposal lapses. With the Northeast monsoon approaching, 1,400 of 1,600 km of stormwater drains are desilted (99%). 215 relief centres and 111 community kitchens are ready. Funds include Rs 1,100 crore to clear pending bills, Rs 300 crore loan, Rs 100 crore for monsoon works; long-term flood projects with World Bank/JICA; 15 IAS officers and seven ministers coordinating measures.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイのデング熱症例が2万人を超える、保健当局は減少傾向にあると発表
triage.triage_reason: 症例数が2万件を超え大規模な行政対応（閣僚・IAS職員・多額予算投入）が行われており、社会的・行政的関心が高いため、WPRO基準（流行しやすさ・曝露継続）とも合致しシグナルとして識別する。
triage.notes: 死亡例なし・減少傾向と報告されており、季節性の既知流行病である点を考慮すると重症度は低い。ただし大規模な行政リソース投入（15名のIAS職員、7名の閣僚、複数の予算措置）がなされており、モンスーン接近による感染継続リスクも存在するため、経過観察の価値はある。

article.articleHeadline: 洗過再冰超致命！一家3口吃炒蛋集體中毒 專家：毀了保護膜　細菌全滲入
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washed and refrozen—deadly! A family of three suffers mass food poisoning after eating scrambled eggs; experts say it damaged the protective barrier and bacteria fully penetrated.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-05, a mother and two other family members in Shenyang, Liaoning Province, China, developed severe acute gastroenteritis after eating scrambled eggs. Health authorities tied the outbreak to eggs that had been washed before refrigeration, which destroyed the shell’s water-soluble protective膜, opening thousands of microscopic pores and allowing Salmonella and other bacteria to penetrate the interior, contaminating both the yolk and white. Despite subsequent refrigeration, bacterial contamination could not be reversed. Laboratory assessment indicated a high probability of Salmonella proliferation within the washed eggs. Experts advise against washing eggs: dry wipe only if dirty, store with the large end up in the refrigerator at 0–4°C, and if eggs are washed, cook immediately or consume within 3 days, keeping them separate from raw foods to prevent cross-contamination.

triage.headline_ja: 洗ってから再冷蔵は致命的！家族3人が炒り卵を食べて集団食中毒　専門家「保護膜が壊れ細菌が浸透した」と指摘
triage.triage_reason: 単一家庭内での食中毒事例であり、公衆衛生上の広範な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められず、社会的関心も限定的と判断される。
triage.notes: 本記事は腸チフス・パラチフスではなくサルモネラ菌による家庭内食中毒事例を扱っており、疾患名タグ（Typhoid/Paratyphoid）と記事内容が一致していない可能性がある。公衆衛生上のアウトブレイクではなく個別家庭の食品衛生に関する注意喚起記事であるため、対象国の公衆衛生イベントとしては計上しない。
